PLATFORM RULES
The Turkish version of the Platform Rules will be made available in the Seller Center for seller convenience as soon as possible.
I. TRENDYOL QUALITY STANDARDS
It is critical for the existence and continuation of our business model that our business partners cooperate with us in maintaining, increasing and sustaining the standards set out in the Platform Rules.

Below, the quality standards governing the products to be listed for sale on our platform, the operational processes to be carried out in the event that these products are purchased by customers, and the communication to be established with the customer in all these processes are explained.

In addition to our quality standards that directly impact the customer experience, our ethical business values and code of conduct, which we embrace to protect the legal rights of all our stakeholders and to sustain a competitive economic environment, are a natural and integral part of our quality standards.
A. PRODUCT QUALITY STANDARDS
The minimum quality standard that a product to be offered to Trendyol customers must meet is given in the table below. A product must fully meet the standards listed under each quality element, to the extent appropriate to its nature.

Defect-free Product

The product must have all the features presented in its images and description, including user instructions and warnings in the specific EU local language where the product will be sold.

The product must meet the material and design criteria to fulfill its intended use.

The product must be undamaged, stored in compliance with all sanitary requirements and in a condition suitable for its intended use.

The product must be unused and, if it is sold in packaging, the packaging must be unopened/undamaged.

The product must fully comply with all applicable EU and local laws, including but not limited to the General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR), and other sector-specific regulations. Sellers must ensure all required safety markings (e.g., CE marking) and documentation are included with the product, if applicable to the product category.

It is forbidden to sell any kind of counterfeit products, in particular, but not limited to, those bearing the name, sign or trademark of a registered trademark on the label, product description or packaging in order to mislead the customer and give the impression that they belong to this trademark.

The product must contain all required elements indicating industrial and intellectual property rights such as all designs, trademarks, patents, if required. Indefinite publications such as books, music and DVDs must be offered for sale with their original banderoles.

All sellers who wish to sell in the book category must present the certificate issued by the relevant authority in their name, otherwise, sales in this category are not allowed.

If required, the product must have undergone the necessary testing and certification procedures prior to placing on the market and must bear certain marks (CE Mark, Food-Contact Material Symbols, Safety Pictograms etc.) and/or other mandatory marks/bandroles issued by the competent authorities for products that have passed conformity tests.

Electronic products and other products for which a warranty certificate is legally required must be delivered to the customer with their original boxes and valid warranty certificates.

Products with expiry dates must be delivered to the customer within a period commensurate with their consumption period until their expiry date.

The product must contain all parts necessary for its use or assembly.

Product Complies with Listing Rules

Product content must include clear and accurate  information where the customer can view the details of product use and content. Listings should include essential details on product usage, contents, and any relevant warnings or precautions. Product content and visual adequacy standards must comply with the required attributes and descriptions given for each product classification, ensuring consistency and regulatory compliance.. Product descriptions must avoid any misleading claims or omissions that could affect customer expectations or safety. Product content and visual adequacy standards can be found in Annex 1.2 [Trendyol Product Listing Rules].

Images or descriptions that include symbols or phrases that are racist, exclusionary, harmful, sexually explicit, or that violate any applicable regulations are strictly prohibited. Images that are prohibited for online sale or fail to meet Trendyol’s image policy are also not allowed.

The uploaded product images/product content must describe the product accurately and only highlight the product.

On the product name/description page, only the own brand of the product put up for sale in the image should be written; different brands should not be written.

Images/descriptions that contain the name or address of a different e-commerce site/shopping channel should not be included on the product page.

Product images must be selected from royalty-free images taken or commissioned by the seller or publicly available.

For all product categories, mandatory attributes are required to be fully completed by the Seller. Trendyol may request additional information or documents on the attributes to check their compliance with the given standard or audit given information to confirm that they are accurate and up-to-date. For products that are not met with these standards may be suspended from the platform without prior notice to protect consumer safety and maintain compliance with regulatory obligations.

Trendyol may conclude a due diligence procedure to confirm that all products that are offered on the platform are compliant with GPSR, customs and other applicable safety regulationss. Sellers are required to cooperate with Trendyol by providing requested information, documentation and any other materials necessary to ensure all products meet legal and safety related regulations and standards.

The final selling prices of the product must be accurate, current and consistent with the actual value of the product.

Discounts applied should be genuine and must not mislead customers regarding the product's value.

Use of General Brands

General Brands meaning the products that are offered without assigning any brands and without containing any brand identifiers, including but not limited to brand names, logos, trademarks or any other elements that could create an association with a specific brand.
1. Unbranded Products
Products that don’t contain any brand elements or offered without referencing or assigning a brand should be listed as “General Brands”.
Sellers should not refer to any made-up/fake brand elements when listing products.
2. Merged Products
Where similar or identical unbranded products are merged under the same listings (including their variants), such listings must be classified and displayed as  General Brands, provided that no brand elements are present across any of the merged products.
3. User Recognition
Products that are listed or merged as “General Brands” will be displayed to the users as General Brands.
4. Prohibited Use of General Brands

Branded products cannot be listed as General Brands
Listing licensed / known branded products as General Brands to disguise their brand recognition is prohibited and violation points shall be assigned to the sellers that are violating the Platform Rules.

B. OPERATIONAL QUALITY STANDARDS
The following table shows the minimum quality standard that all operational processes must meet, from the process of invoicing and delivering a product ordered by Trendyol customers to the customer, to the return process to be carried out when the customer exercises the right of withdrawal or return.

Supply Ability

Sellers must ensure that all products offered for sale are accurately represented and ready for shipment. Before the products are opened for sale, the seller must verify stock levels, pricing and shipment readiness both physically and systematically.

Stock levels must always be accurate and up-to-date to reflect actual availability.

Products must be complete, including all mandatory information, components, and features as described. Incomplete or incorrect items must not be sent to customers.

On-Time Shipping

Ordered products must be delivered to the carrier and updated to “in transit” status in the Trendyol system within the delivery period specified by Trendyol. Sellers will be notified of any changes to the handling time in advance.

Order releases should align with Seller’s daily cargo capacities and should be done before the handling time.

Correct Packaging

Packaging must be robust so that the product is not damaged, and if a product group-specific packaging standard (food, hygiene, glass products, etc.) is specified, it must be complied with. Failure to notify a specific packaging standard for a product does not constitute a justification for not packaging in accordance with the health and safety standards required by the product.

If placed on the package, the delivery note or invoice must not be positioned so that the customer's order information (goods purchased, price) is visible. Only the shipping barcode and address must be visible on the package.

Packaging materials bearing the brands and logos of other e-commerce platforms should not be used.

The package should not contain advertisements that direct Trendyol customers' shopping to different platforms, to other websites or to the seller's own website or store, and coupons specific to use on these websites.

When packaging products, boxes, packaging and packages suitable for the size of the product should be used and it should be checked that the package is transported with the correct deci information when the package is delivered to the carrier company.

Smooth Withdrawal / Return Acceptance

The Seller agrees that if a product is returned by the Purchaser on the grounds that it is defective or based on the right of withdrawal, the evaluation of the Product return request will be made by Trendyol B.V or other Group Companies of DSM.

C. STORE QUALITY STANDARDS
Seller store is a feature that allows our partners to create their own branded stores on the Trendyol platform. The quality standards to be considered when using this feature are given in the table below.

Store Name

The store/brand name must have a minimum of 3 and a maximum of 40 characters.

Special characters (except " ' " and "&") should not be used in the store/brand name.

When determining the store/brand name, extensions such as ".com" and ".net" should not be used.

When determining the name of the store/brand, misleading expressions such as "add to cart, you get a discount, etc." should not be used. It should be clear to the customer that the name is the name of the store/brand, without allowing confusion of any kind.

Sellers can not use as a trademark or shop name a trademark that is not registered in their trade name without the permission of the registrant.

"Trendyol", "Trendyol Express", "Trendyolmilla" trademarks and/or other trademarks of Trendyol and/or similar trademarks of Trendyol cannot be used in the store/brand name.

The store/brand name should not include the names of categories/products that are not suitable for online sales.

The store/brand name should not contain expressions of violence, profanity, discrimination or sexuality or any other words that could violate applicable laws or good morals

Sellers can change their store names; however, changing the store name to confuse the customer's perception of the store is against the platform rules.

Logo and Cover Images

Logo and cover images uploaded to the seller store must comply with Trendyol's policies.

Images with different brand/e-commerce site logos or images that contain content prohibited for internet sales or potentially violating good morals or other people’s rights, are not in compliance with Trendyol's ethics principles and cannot be used as a store logo.

Store logos and cover images may not use any expression whose intellectual property rights or trade names belong to third parties.

Banners (Banner)

Banners/banner ads installed in the Seller store shall direct only to the products and boutiques in Trendyol. Directing to products outside of Trendyol is not allowed.

Product Listing

In order to avoid disruptions in product supply, sales capacities are taken into account when offering products in the store.

D. BUSINESS PARTNERSHIP QUALITY STANDARDS
The basic collaboration quality standard that must be met in order to become a seller on Trendyol is given in the table below. The full compliance of our business partners with these standards is a prerequisite for a healthy and sustainable commercial cooperation.

Respect for Customers' Right to Information

Customer inquiries submitted through the platform must be addressed promptly. The answer given to customers should be accurate and not be misleading, especially not to persuade the customer to buy the product.

The answer given to customers should be accurate and not be misleading, especially not to persuade the customer to buy the product.

The answer given should answer the question asked by the customer. Providing irrelevant answers cannot be interpreted as an answer to the customer's question.

Respect Customers' Right to Choice

Customers communicating with the sellers using the Trendyol platform cannot be contacted directly or indirectly through any channel other than the platform or after the Customer’s question has been answered.

Customers cannot be directed to a return or exchange channel outside the platform.

Customers cannot be asked  to cancel an order or be incentivized to make a purchase.

Protection of Customers' Personal Data

Customers' personal data obtained for the purpose of order fulfillment may be used strictly for that purpose and must not be shared with any parties not directly involved in the fulfillment process. Access to customers' data is restricted to only the information necessary to complete the order, and it may not be accessed, used, or requested for any other purposes, including through different channels. For example, requesting a customer’s phone number from the Courier Company, when not required for order fulfillment, is strictly prohibited.

All handling of customer data must comply with General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), including principles of data minimization, purpose limitation, and strict access control.

Protection of Customers' Personal Rights

Any communication that insults, mocks, accuses, criticizes or harasses the customer is strictly prohibited.

Customers should always be treated with respect and care; even if it is not insulting, it should not be spoken to the customer in a rude language that does not match the Trendyol customer experience.

Protecting Fair and Cooperative Trade

Our business partners must act in good faith, respect and honesty towards all our customers, other sellers on our platform and Trendyol employees in order to ensure a healthy and sustainable commercial relationship.

Trendyol customers cannot be directed to shop and order from a different channel.

Marketing elements such as gift vouchers, coupons, etc. cannot be sent to Trendyol customers in order to encourage shopping from a different shopping channel.

The most up-to-date and accurate data should always be shared with customers and Trendyol. For example, your address, business information, mobile and electronic contact numbers, and stock quantity must be correct, and updates related to these must be transferred to the system immediately.
To ensure compliance with the regulations, including DSA and GPSR, Trendyol may request additional information from Sellers regarding their business operations, product origins, or other relevant disclosures necessary to ensure product safety and traceability.

Our business partners need to be accessible and informed about developments by regularly using the infrastructure and services provided by the platform.

The features, services and rights offered by the platform to sellers cannot be used for any other purpose. For example;
Misuse of the following features and attempts to increase the visibility of products by providing certain material benefits to customers (by providing coupons, discounts, giving money) or by other methods (by buying from its own store or by buying in bulk once) is interpreted as misuse.
● Favoriting
● Number of Clicks
● Number of Store Followers
● Product Reviews
● Seller Score
It is considered abuse if sellers misuse or refrain from using the following features.
Product Reviews: Sellers entering positive review(s) for their products and manipulating the ranking in this way is interpreted as abuse. Same applies to any kind  incentivization promised or provided to the Customer for writing a good product review for their own products or a bad review for the product of another seller.
Buy Box: The platform's product display is in the universal model called "buybox" or "single content". This model is based on creating a single piece of content for a product, regardless of how many different sellers sell it. Thus, all sellers selling the same product can be listed under the content created for that product, according to a ranking rule whose conditions are predetermined and publicized. The relevant rules are detailed in the Monitoring and Analysis Support section of this document and in the Academy Trainings. With buybox system, customers can more easily find and compare the products they are looking for, and sellers can more easily deliver their products to customers. In this context, if there is a barcode previously created for a product in Trendyol, the product should be listed using this barcode.
Avoiding Buy Box competition by deliberately multiplexing barcodes or entering Buy Box with a product with a different brand/specification is interpreted as an abuse of the Buy Box application. Sellers are required to check in detail the content defined in the barcode of a product they upload and open for sale through the Trendyol Catalog and make sure that the details in the content are exactly the same as the product they want to list. When sellers sell a product that differs from the content defined on the barcode, they will be responsible for customer complaints and claims regarding this difference. In the Trendyol Catalog, when you click on the "See on Trendyol" tab on the pop-up screen that appears in the step of opening the product for sale, you can access the detailed description of the product defined in the barcode.
Sellers who commit the Buy Box violations listed below will have their products closed for sale.
● Creating multiple / separate content for the same product
● Multiplexing an existing product in the Trendyol Catalog on the platform by differentiating the brand (Multiplexed content is locked by moving it under the correct branded product. If the necessary documents related to the product are submitted, the products can be opened for sale again. During the determination of the right branded product, attention is paid to the turnover of the brands, their views by customers and the rate at which brand views turn into sales)
● Entering a products’ assigned barcode to a different product
● Changing the product content in a way that negatively affects the trade of other sellers (changing details such as images, content information, etc.)
In the case of barcode multiplexing discussed in the first bullet point, the multiplexed content can be completely closed for sale by Trendyol, or it can be combined under the correct barcode. In the case of combining multiplexed content with different brands, brand information may not be displayed to customers. The consolidation made by Trendyol is based on the information entered by the seller. Therefore, if the situation referred to in the second point above occurs because the information defined in the multiplexed barcode created by the seller does not reflect the reality, the seller will be fully responsible for this situation.
Sellers' use of the following features to mislead Trendyol and customers is considered abuse.

Marking the “shipped/in transit” option for a product that has not been physically delivered to the cargo

Sending empty cargo or deliberately sending the wrong product to the customer in order to avoid the sanction of non-supply

The features, services and rights offered by the Platform to customers may not be used to negatively affect the trade of another seller. For example, it is unacceptable to misuse the following features to adversely affect another seller's trade or to artificially favor one's own trade.
● Customer Reviews
● Product Reviews
● Ask Seller a Question Option
● Giving Feedback Button
Orders that lead to the exploitation of discounts created by the seller for the benefit of its customers.

A seller shall open one seller account. The same seller opening different seller accounts will be interpreted as abuse unless the seller can provide a legally justifiable reason for this.

No statements, accusations and criticisms should be made in any media channels in a way that will damage the reputation of Trendyol platform, target or discredit Trendyol or its business partners. This shall not limit the seller's right to seek legal remedies.

Inappropriate behavior and insults should not be made against Trendyol, Trendyol employees, customers and sellers.

Trendyol's trade secrets and operational processes that our business partners become aware of in the course of  their commercial activities are strictly confidential and must not be disclosed to customers or any other third parties.

E. COMPLIANCE WITH LEGAL REGULATIONS
The basic legal compliance requirements that must be observed in order to become a seller on Trendyol are given in the table below. Meeting these standards in full is an indispensable prerequisite for ensuring the continuity and quality of your trading within the platform. However, even if not included in the table below, our business partners must be aware of and strictly comply with the requirements of all applicable laws and regulations that directly affect their business.

Protection of Intellectual Property Rights

Protection of Trademark Rights: We support the branding process of our business partners and value the quality improvement that can be achieved through branding. That is why we provide all registered trademarks with the equal protection required by law. Therefore, we provide equal protection to all registered trademarks as required by law. In this context, you can find the rules you should pay attention to when defining a brand for your products or store in the Annex 1.4 Seller Store Policies of Use. In case of infringement, we reserve the right to take appropriate legal action in accordance with applicable EU and local laws.

Protection of Copyright/Design/Utility Model and Patent Rights: We value the protection and enhancement of product quality and diversity on our platform. Therefore, we expect our business partners not to use works, designs and patents that they do not have the right to use. In case of a violation we reserve the right to take the necessary legal actions in line with applicable EU and local laws.

Image Rights Protection: We value our sellers' investment in images to maintain and improve image quality on our platform. Therefore, we expect our business partners not to use anyone's copyrighted product image without permission. In case of a violation, we will take the necessary legal actions.

Complying with Digital Services Act (DSA)

As mandated by the DSA, Trendyol commits to implementing robust systems to monitor and address Intellectual Property violations on our platform. We encourage business partners to report any suspected Intellectual Property infringements promptly, enabling us to take timely action in accordance with EU regulatory standards.

Protection of Consumer Rights

The obligations imposed by the applicable EU consumer protection laws should not be violated.

Suitability for Sale on the Internet

Only products that are not prohibited for sale on the internet can be sold on our platform. It should be checked whether the products to be listed are suitable for sale on the internet in accordance with the relevant legislation and only products suitable for sale should be listed with a visual/name/description suitable for sale. The list of products prohibited for sale on our platform can be found in “Products Not Suitable for Sale on Trendyol”

II. ENSURING COMPLIANCE WITH TRENDYOL QUALITY STANDARDS
A.   ENSURING COMPLIANCE WITH THE GOOD TRADE SYSTEM
The purpose of the measures taken in case of violations of Trendyol business partnership and quality standards is to improve the commercial activities of our valued business partners and thus improve the shopping experience of Trendyol customers. For this reason, the sanctions to be imposed by Trendyol have been handled in a way to raise awareness among our business partners about their operational competencies and encourage compliance.
COMMON VIOLATION POINTS SYSTEM
Our business partners must manage the commercial relationship with their stakeholders on Trendyol in an honest and fair manner and comply with Trendyol platform's code of conduct. The management of communication between our business partners and our customers is subject to strict controls as it involves important responsibilities such as protecting the personal rights of the customer and ensuring their security. If it is determined that the principles mentioned in this section are violated during the checks, the following points will be reflected on the “Violations” screen on the Seller Panel, and the sales of the seller whose point total reaches certain thresholds will be suspended temporarily or indefinitely according to the points received.
Seller account (Turkey, Micro Export and all sales made through the platforms where Trendyol and its group companies provide intermediary services as an online platform, regardless of who the contracting party is), the total number of violation points;
In case it reaches 12: it is suspended for 2 days
In case it reaches 24: it is suspended for 5 days
If it reaches 36: it is suspended for 7 days.
In the relevant system, each point is deleted within 6 months from the date of issue, unless the relevant seller account reaches 48 points, resulting in account closure. Violation points obtained from failure to upload documents proving originality; or obtained from failure to upload documents showing License, Patent, Copyright, Image Usage Rights  or obtained from Infringement of Content Quality (Buybox Infringements) will be deleted 3 months after the date of occurrence. However, if the relevant Seller account reaches 48 points and is directly closed, these points will not be deleted.

Platform Compatibility

Redirection to a Different Shopping Platform

Directing Trendyol customers to different shopping channels and preventing them from receiving services from Trendyol is against our rules of fair and cooperative trade ethics.
Therefore;
1) Using the customer questions feature to direct customers to different shopping channels,
2) Adding advertisements/promotional materials with coupons and discounts in the post for a direct referral to a different shopping channel purpose,
3) In case of advertising and promotion of a different shopping medium on the product page, violation points will be reflected to the seller.

4

Responding to customer questions in violation of quality standards

Customer inquiries must be responded to in an accurate, relevant, respectful and timely manner in accordance with our fair and cooperative business ethics. In this regard, the seller who responds to customer questions in violation of quality standards in the following ways will be assigned a violation point.
1) Providing an answer on the customer questions screen that has nothing to do with the customer question (it is written in the description, we will reply to you during working hours, etc.)
2) Providing a misleading answer (not matching the characteristics of the product, etc.)
3) Determining the use of language in a way that negatively affects the customer experience (not including insults/threats/harassment; however, rude and disrespectful responses are considered within this scope. For insulting answers, the violation points to be applied in case of insult will be reflected).
4) The seller's giving an answer that conveys Trendyol business and operation processes to the customer in a false and misleading way (Referring Trendyol’s error regarding the order processes even though there isn’t any error made by Trendyol, Trendyol’s cargo quota, and Trendyol business processes to the customer, as well as giving answers that are not solution-oriented and do not reflect the truth are considered against our fair / cooperative trade rule).
5) Directing the customer to cancel the order from the customer questions screen

4

Reaching the Customer Directly

Our sellers must reach Trendyol customers through the communication channels provided by the Trendyol platform.
1) Sellers providing or requesting contact information (phone, e-mail address, etc.) for the purpose of reaching the customer directly through the screens for answering customer questions or product reviews,
2) The seller calls/texts the customer's phone number, sends an e-mail to the customer, reaches the customer through social media channels or other channels, or requests such information from the customer in order to communicate through these channels,
3) In cases such as requesting communication by adding a business card or phone number / e-mail address in the cargo shipment, the seller will be receiving a violation point.

4

Not responding or not responding properly to “Order Inquiries” or customer requests submitted by the Customer Experience team

Violation points will be applied to the seller in cases where the seller responds "I will supply" or "I will exchange" to customers' requests for missing, defective or incorrect products via the Order Questions screen and does not supply or exchange the product within the allotted time, or does not send a shipping code to the customer / transmits an incorrect shipping code.
In addition, violation points are also applied to sellers who do not respond at all or do not respond at a very high rate to customer requests forwarded by the customer experience team.

2

Creating Unrealistic Followers / Likes / Positive Product Reviews / Engaging in Ranking Disruptive Behavior

All evaluations of the product should be made by real customers who have purchased the product.
Violation points will be given when sellers attempt to influence product reviews through the following methods:
1) The seller creating/allowing the creation of unreal orders from customer accounts belonging to himself or his relatives
2) Seller offers customers a discount if they give a positive review
3) The seller purchases/attempts to purchase product reviews, product scores, number of followers, number of clicks or number of favorites from a center

12

Abusing Platform Features

Platform features must be used for their intended purpose and in accordance with the honesty/fair trade rule. Any seller found to have misused these features to harm another seller's business or customer will be assessed infringement points. Sample breaching behaviors in this context are given below.
1)   Use of the Q&A and Product Page areas in a way that harms another seller's business (e.g. defamation of other sellers by claiming that they sell poor quality or non-genuine products, etc.).
2)   Exploiting the discounts/benefits created by the seller for its customers by ordering from another Trendyol seller store
3)   Making it difficult for the seller to trade by ordering from another Trendyol seller store (e.g. stock consumption, malicious comments, deliberate returns, etc.)
4)   Copying the tags (successful seller, fast delivery, etc.) given by Trendyol in accordance with certain rules and adding them to the product page or store images without permission
5)   Misuse of the website by providing misleading information about the scale, price and patterns of products

6

Illegal Use of Data

Our sellers should use the data (customer data, order data, platform screens, employee information, etc.) they obtain during their sale in accordance with the rule of confidentiality and honesty and the relevant legislation. Any seller who shares non-public confidential data obtained through Trendyol with third parties in violation of the relevant legislation will receive a violation score.

2

Inappropriate behavior to Trendyol customers

In case of verbal or written communication containing insult / threat / harassment with a Trendyol customer through Trendyol platform channels such as product and order questions, product comments, product page, violation points will be applied to the seller. Expressions and behaviors that do not involve threats of violence or physical harm, are isolated and non-persistent, and are of a humiliating, rude, or offensive nature are considered mild insults, threats, and harassment. This includes, for example, using rude and degrading forms of address, employing profanity, making comments with a sarcastic or demeaning tone, or sending a one-time disturbing or inappropriate message.)

2

Inappropriate behavior to Trendyol employees and Business Partners

In case of unlawful verbal or written communication with a Trendyol employee through Trendyol's channels such as live support, call center, etc., containing insult/threat/harassment, violation points will be applied to the seller. Expressions and behaviors that do not involve threats of violence or physical harm, are isolated and non-persistent, and are of a humiliating, rude, or offensive nature are considered mild insults, threats, and harassment. This includes, for example, using rude and degrading forms of address, employing profanity, making comments with a sarcastic or demeaning tone, or sending a one-time disturbing or inappropriate message.

6

Defamation/ discrediting on social platforms

Our business partners should not make statements and accusations that do not reflect the truth and aim only to discredit the Trendyol platform. If an allegation is found to be untrue and purely defamatory, the seller will be given a violation point based on those actions.

2

Insults/threats on social platforms

If insulting statements are made against Trendyol through public channels, violation points will be given.

4

Original Product Sales

Uploading a Non-Original Document

If it is determined that the invoice/authorized seller certificate/brand registration certificate uploaded by the seller to the Trendyol system is not original, violation points will be reflected to the seller.

48

Sale of Non-Original Products and Products with Strong Suspicion of Originality

If it is determined that the product listed/sold by the seller is not original or that it carries a strong suspicion of originality, violation points will be given to the seller.

48

Sale of Products with Suspicion of Originality

If indicators are detected that the product listed/sold by the seller is not original, the seller will be given a violation point.

48

Failure to upload documents proving authenticity

During the document process initiated in response to the trademark right holder's notification or customer complaints, the seller failed to submit the necessary documents within the allotted time and the product was closed for sale.

2

Failure to Upload Documents Indicating License, Patent, Work, Image Usage Rights

During the document process initiated in response to the right holder's notification, the seller failed to submit the necessary documents within the allotted time and the product was closed for sale.
The seller can reopen the product for sale by uploading documents; however, the seller who fails to fulfill the responsibility of uploading documents within 30 days after the product is closed for sale will be given violation points.

4

Failure to Upload Documents Proving the Personal Rights

If the seller fails to provide the required documents within the specified period during the documentation process initiated in response to a rights holder’s notification, violation points will be assigned to the seller.

4

Repeated Failure to Upload Documents Proving Ownership of Intellectual and Industrial Property Rights, Including Trademark, License, Patent, Work, and Visual Materials

If the seller repeatedly fails to provide the required documents within the specified period during the documentation process initiated in response to a rights holder’s notification, violation points will be assigned to the seller.

12

Use of Trendyol Store Name and/or Store Imagery in a Manner that Infringes the Intellectual and Industrial Property Rights of a Third Party

In the event that it is determined—either upon the notification of the right holder or as a result of an internal investigation—that the seller is using the store name and/or store imagery in a manner that infringes upon the intellectual and industrial property rights of a third party, violation points will be issued to the seller.

48

Content Quality

Listing and/or Sending an Illegal Product

Violation points will be reflected to the seller who lists and / or sends a product that is prohibited for sale not only on the internet but also by the relevant laws and / or whose sale constitutes a crime.

8

Listing and/or Sending a Product Posing a Health Risk

A seller who lists and/or sending a product that is prohibited for sale on the internet or Trendyol by changing the category, not writing the image/name/description correctly, or using the bundled sales feature, and thus bypassing quality controls and putting a product with a high health risk on sale will be charged a violation point.

6

Listing and/or Sending a Prohibited Product for Sale on the Internet

Sellers who list a product that is prohibited for sale on the internet will be assessed infringement points.
Within the scope of takedown decisions from ministries, courts and other authorized institutions and organizations, if a content has become prohibited for sale on the internet as of the date of the decision, no violation points are applied to the seller.
However, if the seller republishes the content despite the decision without making the necessary corrections, the infringement score will be reflected.

4

Relisting Products Classified as “Unsafe Products” Under Product Safety Legislation

Micro Export Violation Points System:

For the avoidance of doubt, for violations under this heading, there is no restriction on a seller's sales to Turkey that are not within the scope of micro-exports; actions are taken with respect to sales to Turkey only by taking into account the violation points calculated within the Common Violation Points System, and this calculation does not include the violation points within the Micro Export Violation Points Application under any circumstances.

reaches 12: for 2 days
reaches 24: for 5 days
reaches 36: for 7 days
reaches 48: for 180 days

the seller's account will be closed to Micro Export and during this period the seller can only continue sales within Turkey. Each point in the relevant calculation will be deleted within 6 months from the date of issue.
