B. ENSURING COMPLIANCE WITH PRODUCT QUALITY STANDARDS
All products entered into the platform by our sellers and their publication status are available under the "Product" tab in the Seller Center. Products that have passed the product approval process, are on the campaign/search screens and are actively on sale, can be accessed from the "On Sale" tab. In the following cases, you may have a product that is on sale removed from publication.

Product
Ensuring Compliance with Quality Standards

In the following cases, the sale or visibility of your relevant products on the platform may be suspended or reduced. You can access information about your products whose sales have been suspended for any reason from the "Locked Products" tab on your Seller Panel and you can reopen your products for sale by following the necessary steps.

Quality Problem

Preventive Provision

Visual/Content Inappropriateness

Product images and content uploaded to Trendyol must meet quality standards that clearly describe the product and emphasize only the product itself. Images or content featuring different brand logos, e-commerce site references, model logos, or visuals prohibited for sale on the internet are not compliant with Trendyol policies. Products flagged for noncompliance may be temporarily removed from sale following Trendyol’s review or customer complaint, in accordance with the applicable regulations. Products that are removed from sale can be reopened if sellers revise the images or content, provided the product itself is not inherently unsuitable for online sale.

Excessively High Price

Trendyol does not intervene in sellers' prices; however, if the Trendyol Selling Price (TSP) set in Turkey by the Seller for a product is above the average price in local storefront of the product on Trendyol (155% for products up to 100 TL, 105% for products up to 3,000TL, and 75% for products over 3,000TL), the visibility given to the product in European countries (micro export) may also be reduced to prevent damage to the seller and customers due to suspicion of incorrect price entry. If the price drops below extremely high price thresholds, the product will automatically start receiving visibility again.
In addition to the algorithm whose working principle is described above, in order to prevent our sellers from entering incorrect prices, products that are detected to be overpriced in automatic controls can also be moved to the locked product screen and the seller can be asked to check the price. The seller can easily re-open the product for sale by confirming the price.
For products with relatively high unit prices such as electronic goods and basic necessities such as diapers and toilet paper, the same procedures can be applied for price differences lower than those mentioned above, as the market sensitivity to price increases is higher for these products.

Extremely Low Price

Trendyol does not intervene in the prices of sellers; however, if the Trendyol Selling Price (TSF) set in Turkey by the Seller for a product is 70% below the average price in local storefront of the product on Trendyol, the product in European countries (micro export) may be moved to the locked product screen as a precautionary measure and the seller is requested to confirm the price of the product in order to prevent the seller and customers from being harmed due to the suspicion of incorrect price entry and inability to supply. The seller can easily re-open the product for sale by confirming the price.

Inappropriate use of images

If any word is searched, and products from sensitive categories such as sexual and fantasy items, which require sensitivity due to legal regulations, general morality, and public order, are also listed on the results pages, the visibility of these products may be reduced to prevent harm to sellers and customers.

Safe Product

The seller shall exclusively offer safe products on the Platform that comply with the applicable laws and regulations of the European Union. The seller bears full responsibility for performing comprehensive due diligence on the products made available for sale. This includes but is not limited to, ensuring product safety and quality, confirming accurate labeling and packaging, and keeping all documentation current to demonstrate compliance with relevant regulations.
Failure to meet these obligations may result in the suspension of product listings or Seller accounts, in line with the Platform’s policies and applicable regulations. Sellers will be notified of the reasons for such actions and provided with an opportunity to appeal.

C. ENSURING COMPLIANCE WITH OPERATION QUALITY STANDARDS
The following measures can be applied to our business partners that fail to meet operational service quality standards in order to ensure customer satisfaction and improve their processes.

Operational
Ensuring Compliance with Quality Standards

Quality Problem

Preventive Provision

High Rate of Seller Failure to Supply

Based on the past performance of our sellers, we calculate their daily output capacities and accordingly determine the probability that a seller will be able to ship pending orders within the deadline. As a result of this determination, the visibility of the products of the sellers, who have been downgraded to "red" status for not shipping in the last 72 hours despite having an overdue order, is temporarily minimized on the site. Our sellers can track their status on the "My Operation Capacity Status" screens on the seller center. Within the calculated month, sellers who have remained in red status more than once on this screen -for the reason mentioned above-, who have failed to achieve the targeted performance in non-supply metrics, are put into vacation mode by notifying them 3 business days in advance in order not to become unable to fulfill their seller obligations due to non-supply and not to create customer victimization. The seller who is put in vacation mode can exit the vacation mode after 24 hours by completing the necessary transactions on the seller center without opening any notification. If the same situation repeats in the seller performance, the seller store will be suspended due to "high rate of non-supply" with 3 business days notice.
The Seller must inform via "support" or the relevant operations officer that the inability to supply has been resolved by performing the following improvements as appropriate before suspension (within 3 business days of being notified of the suspension) or during the period of suspension:
i) Entering product stocks into the system as 2 units less than the current stock (safety stock)
ii) Stocktaking for the product that cannot be supplied
iii) If the problem persists, stocktaking in all product groups
iv) If it is an integration-related problem, sharing the cause of the problem and the details of the improvement made to prevent it from happening again
If the inability to supply is a problem that cannot be solved by implementing the specified improvements, the seller should provide information about its findings and the improvements it has made. After the information provided by the seller is evaluated by the relevant Trendyol teams, if it is concluded that the seller's inability to supply is resolved, the seller will be opened for sale again.

Seller's High Defective / Incorrect / Incomplete Product Return Rate

Considering customer satisfaction, if the seller exceeds the targeted value of the monthly/weekly/daily defective, incorrect, and missing product return rate (number of products returned due to defective + missing + incorrect items / number of products obligated to supply), or if customer complaints arise due to these reasons, in order to prevent damage caused by defective, incorrect, and missing shipments and to maintain customer satisfaction, the seller's account may be suspended

Risk of Delay in Orders Due to Seller's Insufficient Capacity

Trendyol conducts quality audits in order to control quality problems that may cause customer victimization before they occur. In this context, daily output capacities of sellers are calculated according to their past performances, and accordingly, the probability of sellers to ship their pending orders within the deadline is determined, the seller operation status - Green, Yellow, Orange, Red - is calculated in 2-hour periods and visibility actions are taken.
Sellers who do not release products despite having a pending order are considered to be at risk of delays in advance.
Seller operation states:
Red: A situation where the seller's current operational performance cannot meet the sales volume or orders are delayed, and the risk of delay in new orders is high. It is shown with "Very Risky" information in the Seller panel. Pending orders should be shipped immediately. The visibility of the seller's products and store on the platform is temporarily minimized. (Products can be purchased by customers, but cannot be found in the search bar, favorites, collections, etc.)
Orange: Seller's current operational performance is insufficient compared to sales or orders are delayed. It is shown with "Risky" information in the Seller Center. Delayed orders and orders at risk of delay must be delivered to the cargo immediately. Temporary visibility reduction actions are taken on the seller's products on the platform.  Products can be purchased by customers. The seller's product ranking (buybox, store, etc.) is lowered.
Yellow: The risk of order delays is foreseen unless the seller's current operational performance improves. It is shown with "Low Risk" information in the seller panel. Orders that are delayed or at risk of delay must be delivered to the cargo immediately. No visibility action is taken in the seller store due to the operation status.
Green: Seller operation status is "Normal" and at the expected level, no visibility action is taken due to the operation status.

Reaching a High Defective / Incorrect/Missing Product Return Rate

If there is an increase in the ratio of returns due to defective/incorrect/missing products (to your total sales and this ratio is over the average of other companies selling in the relevant product category, the sale of your related products may be stopped. The restriction will continue until you meet the criteria that your operational capability has improved. You can access information about your products whose sales have been suspended for any reason from the "Locked Products" tab on your Seller Center and you can reopen your products for sale by following the necessary steps.

Failure to Supply

Failure to supply shall be deemed to be a failure to supply and shall be subject to penalty conditions.
-Cancellation of all or part of the product(s) in the order by the seller for any reason
-In cases where the product is shown as shipped and it is determined that there is no physical departure.
-Feeding the wrong status by abusing the system when there is no physical product output
-Failure to remove the ordered products from the cargo package sent to the customer (sending empty boxes, etc.)
-And all cases other than the above-mentioned cases where the ordered product or service does not reach the customer due to reasons originating from the seller.
- At least 5 business days have passed since the end of the order's deadline, but the order has not been transferred to the "in transit" status
- If the Seller fails to deliver the product(s) within fifteen (15) calendar days from the end of the Handling Time which is a maximum of two (2) business days from the purchase date, and/or does not update the order status to "in transit” on the Seller Center, Trendyol reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to cancel the order for the undelivered product(s).
If the products in the order are canceled separately at different times, a separate penalty calculation is made for each cancellation.

Delay Status

You must deliver your products to the cargo within the promised deadline and make sure that the order is in "in transit" status. Otherwise, the delay is subject to penalty terms.
If an order is split into two or more shipments, the above calculation is made separately for each shipment.
If the failure to supply occurs after the promised cargo delivery time has passed, the failure to supply penalty and delay penalty will be reflected together.

Selecting the Product Shipped Option before the Product is Physically Delivered to the Cargo

It is a violation, which is considered an abuse of platform features, to mark the product with “shipped/in transit” option for a product that has not yet been physically shipped by the seller. When this violation occurs, a cargo that is not in motion will appear to be in motion on the system. This not only prevents the customer from exercising their right to cancel, but also extends the delivery time of the product and even prevents the customer from receiving a refund for a product that will never be supplied. In order to prevent customer victimization caused by the violation in question, orders subject to cargoes whose status does not change despite being seen in motion are returned by the Platform at the end of 3 business days.

-  Ensuring Compliance with the Good Trade System
-  Ensuring Compliance with Product Quality Standards
-  Ensuring Compliance with Operation Quality Standards
The restrictions that Trendyol will put into effect in the event of a breach of the criteria determined and detailed in line with the quality standards required by each heading are detailed in Annex 1.6 [Sales Restrictions to be Implemented in Case of Breach of Trendyol Quality Standards].
Sellers will be notified of any breaches of quality standards, including specific metrics and corrective steps.
Sellers may appeal penalties or restrictions within the designated reasonable timeframe by Trendyol on a case-by-case basis. Appeals will be reviewed, and resolutions will be communicated to Sellers in a timely manner.

III. AUDITING COMPLIANCE WITH TRENDYOL QUALITY STANDARDS
Monitoring compliance with Trendyol Quality Standards is an important quality control process that we carry out in cooperation with our business partners. The aim of the audit activities is to ensure that all processes of our business partners, starting from the moment of product loading to delivery, comply with Trendyol Quality Standards. Our aim is to prevent a quality problem that will negatively affect customer satisfaction before it occurs. In this context, the immediate elimination of quality problems reflected to the customer and, if deemed necessary, the imposition of sanctions to prevent non-compliance with standards are also an integral part of our quality control process.
A. Predicate Audits
Proactive audits are pre-emptive quality audits that are put in place to prevent quality problems before they occur. The table below describes both the relevant Trendyol processes and what our business partners need to do in these processes.

Product/Content Conformity Check

Only products that comply with Trendyol Platform Rules and are suitable for sale on the internet can pass the quality control audit with approval. General information about which products will not be approved and why can be found in Annex 1.1 [Products Not Eligible for Sale on Trendyol]
Product/Content audits also include product listing quality-specific aspects such as product visual quality, content adequacy and accuracy.
Information about the products that have not been approved at this stage and are therefore not available for sale can be found in the "Approval Process" tab on the Seller Center.
If the contents and images of the products on sale are updated, the relevant products will be subject to the product approval process again.
Products that do not pass the quality control check at the time of product listing/update, but are nevertheless not in compliance with the Platform Rules and/or are not suitable for sale on the internet, will be removed immediately as soon as they are noticed.
No product sold on the internet, especially cosmetic products and food supplements, should contain statements defined as health declarations. This list is available on the Platform.

Pre-Document Control for Branded Products

Registered trademarks notified to Trendyol by the right holders are subject to the preliminary document control process.
When a product listing is requested by entering the name of a trademark within this scope, the request automatically comes before the team of experts responsible for running the trademark protection program.
At this stage, the seller may list the products of the brand in question if it presents a certificate of authorization proving that it can sell the products of the brand in question or invoices showing that the products were purchased from an authorized dealer. The number of products on the invoice should be sufficient to verify authenticity, and high stock entries should not be made against invoices showing very low quantity purchases.
In the event that sales are made/orders are received twice (100% more) than the number of stocks shown on the invoice uploaded to the system for the release of the products, the products may be immediately closed for sale due to the risk of authenticity. In this case, in order to continue the sale, a new invoice must be uploaded to the system, which is different from the previously uploaded invoice and which can meet the additional stock required by the products sold/ordered. If the new invoice requested is uploaded to the system, the products will be re-published.
Products that do not pass the preliminary document control filter due to sellers entering the brand name incorrectly, but are found to be unauthentic as a result of routine checks, shadow orders, customer complaints or notifications by trademark right holders, are immediately removed from publication.

Extreme Low / Extreme High Price Control

In order to protect the rights of our sellers and customers, our sellers are informed about the prices that are caught in the excessively low or excessively high price algorithm and are requested to correct any inaccuracies in their prices. This prevents negative consequences such as sellers canceling orders for products they list at too low a price, creating customer victimization or not making any sales at all.

Operation Capacity Status Check

Quality audits are carried out in order to control quality problems that may cause customer victimization before they occur. In this context, the daily output capacities of sellers are calculated according to their past shipping performances, and accordingly, the probability of sellers to ship their pending orders within the deadline is determined, the seller operation status - Green, Yellow, Orange, Red - is calculated in 2-hour periods and visibility actions are taken.

B. Consecutive Audits
Reactive audits are successive quality audits that are conducted after a quality problem is experienced, in order to provide an immediate solution to maintain customer satisfaction and uphold quality standards.

Authenticity Check Process Upon Notification of Infringement

Pursuant to the Digital Services Act and other relevant EU and local regulations and directives for online platforms (Regulation),  the infringement notifications (including all information and documents required by the Regulation to verify right ownership) submitted to Trendyol by trademark, license, patent, work or design right holders or their representatives shall be processed immediately. Upon receipt of a credible infringement notification—substantiated by evidence of potential rights infringement—the product listing in question shall be temporarily suspended. The seller will be promptly notified and required to submit documentation demonstrating the authenticity of the product, including necessary authorization documents, within a period not exceeding 48 hours. If, upon review, the submitted documentation is found to satisfy authenticity requirements under the Regulation, the product listing will be reinstated. Should the seller fail to provide adequate documentation within the 48-hour period, or if the documentation submitted is deemed insufficient, the product listing shall remain deactivated until the Seller demonstrates with documentation the authenticity of the product in this context, the seller who puts on sale the products targeted by a valid notification transmitted through the panel by a seller with trademark rights is given 36 hours to upload the documents proving the authenticity of the product (including all the information and documents specified in the Regulation to prove the validity of the objection) to the relevant area on the seller center. If the seller fails to upload the relevant documents within this period, or if the documents uploaded are deemed insufficient by the relevant teams and not accepted, the product will be removed from publication. In violation notifications from non-panel channels in accordance with the Regulation, in order to manage the 48-hour legal period correctly, the products subject to the violation notification are first closed for sale; then the seller is expected to upload the documents proving the authenticity of the product and put the product back online.  If the items are closed, they will be relaunched when the seller uploads documents proving authenticity. For a product content, the seller has the right to upload documents up to 5 times. On the 5th time, the seller who uploads insufficient documents that are not suitable for acceptance cannot upload documents for the same content again for 1 month.
In the case of image infringement notices, the notifying party must submit raw footage proving the ownership of the images. If a valid image infringement notice is received with sufficient supporting evidence, it is anticipated that the seller of the alleged image infringement will be unlikely to upload a counter-document. Consequently, the sale of the affected products will be temporarily suspended to prevent further unauthorized use.  If the seller whose product listing has been suspended can establish rights to the image by sending a counter-document, they may reinstate the listing on the Platform by updating the image as necessary. In cosmetic products and food supplements (vitamins, etc.), trademark infringement notifications made by the trademark right holder or its representative may be processed immediately. Given  the potential health risks associated with non-genuine products, the sale of such products may be temporarily suspended, after which the seller will be required by Trendyol to submit documentation proving the product’s authenticity. Upon verification, the seller may reinstate the product listing on the Platform.

Sales Limits and Performance Controls in Locked Brands and Categories

In the Platform, there is a special sales limit policy for sellers who are new to selling or have been inactive for a long time in categories where there is a risk of failing to meet authenticity and/or customer performance criteria under locked brands.
These sellers can start selling with a limited stock quantity when they wish to sell in the relevant locked brands and categories. Sellers who sell within the specified limited stock quantity will have their products closed for sale for a period determined by the rule set or have their product visibility reduced to a minimum level (Products can be purchased by customers; however, they cannot be found via the search bar, favorites, collections, etc.) once they sell their allocated stock quantity, and the products' performance will be evaluated.
As a result of the evaluation, if the seller receives violation points due to the products sold or for any other reason, or if their performance metrics are deemed negative in any way, they will continue with the same sales limit at the end of the period specified in the ruleset. However, if no issues are found in the seller's performance, the initial limits offered to the seller will be increased, and a new limit will be set. The same process will be repeated with the newly determined limit.
If the seller's performance in the limited sales process is deemed satisfactory as a result of phased checks, the seller's sales limit is completely removed and they can continue selling with the stock quantity defined in the documentation processes.

.These sales limits only affect the sales processes within the scope of the relevant locked brand and category and do not create any restrictions on sales in other brands and categories.

Authenticity Verification Process Conducted Based on Fraud Complaints Submitted by Customers via Reviews & Customer Support

1. Fraud Complaints from Customer Reviews:
If a customer's fraud complaint is submitted directly through product reviews, the product in question is immediately removed from sale and the document upload process is initiated. If the seller successfully uploads documents proving the authenticity of the product and these documents are approved by our expert teams, the product may be put back on sale.
2. Counterfeit Complaints Received Through Customer Support:
For counterfeit complaints received through the customer support channel, the product is placed in the documentation process. The seller is given 36 hours to upload documents proving the authenticity of the product. If the documents are not uploaded within this period or if the uploaded documents are deemed insufficient, the product is removed from sale. If the documents are confirmed to be complete and valid, the product is put back on sale.

This distinction is applied to enable a faster and more effective response based on the source of the counterfeit complaint.

Customer Feedbacks

To prioritize customer satisfaction, all feedback regarding products and sellers on our platform is carefully reviewed.
Documented Customer Complaints: All complaints and feedback provided by customers that can be documented (e.g., supported by relevant documentation) are immediately evaluated.
Undocumented Complaints and Other Feedback: For complaints where customers cannot provide documentation or submit them through different methods, we also consider any increase in similar complaints about the relevant product or seller. This helps us identify a general trend or potential issue.
Product Page “Give Feedback” Button: Notifications from customers via the “Give Feedback” button on product pages regarding errors in the product name, price, image, or name/content are also important sources of complaints. When such a notification is made, the complaint is immediately reviewed. If an error is actually found in the elements subject to the complaint, the product's traffic is reduced and a warning is sent to the seller to make the necessary corrections. Once the seller has made the necessary corrections, the product's traffic returns to normal.
Closing Products in Case of Violation: If, as a result of customer feedback reviews, it is determined that the products offered for sale violate the Platform Rules, the relevant processes are initiated and the products are removed from sale.

Criteria-based Originality Controls

A Criteria-Based Authenticity Control Process is implemented for sellers operating on our platform. Within the framework of established rulesets, this system evaluates the reliability levels of sellers and products based on objective criteria and generates a trust score.
Products identified with a low trust score will be subjected to the originality control processes detailed in the text above. In such cases, the seller listing the products is granted 144 hours to upload documentation requested as part of the originality control process(including all information and documents specified in the Regulation to prove the validity of the objection) to the designated area on the Seller Panel.
If the seller fails to upload the relevant documents within this period, or if the uploaded documents are deemed insufficient and rejected by the expert teams, the product will be removed from the platform. In any event, if the relevant documents are accepted, the product will be reactivated for sale or remain live on the platform.

Order Limits and Performance Controls Applied on Locked Brands and Locked Categories

A specific sales limit application is implemented on our platform for sellers who are either new to the platform or have been inactive for a long period, specifically in categories under "Locked Brands" that present a risk of failing to meet customer performance criteria and platform quality standards.

When these sellers wish to operate within the relevant Locked Brands and categories, they may begin selling with a limited stock quantity. Once sellers reach their defined stock limits, a performance evaluation is conducted. During this evaluation period—the duration of which is determined by specific rule sets—the products may either be deactivated or their visibility may be reduced to a minimum level. (In the latter case, products remain purchasable by customers but cannot be found via the search bar, favorites, collections, etc.).

As a result of this evaluation:

If the seller receives violation points due to the sold products or other reasons, or if their performance metrics are deemed negative, they will continue with the same sales limit at the end of the designated period.

If no issues are found in the seller's performance, the initial limits are increased, and a new limit is set. The same process is then repeated with the newly established limit.

If the seller’s performance is deemed appropriate following these phased controls, the sales limit is completely removed, and the seller may continue sales.

These sales limits only affect the sales processes within the scope of the relevant Locked Brand and category; they do not create any restrictions on sales in other brands and categories.

Product Safety Controls

In accordance with the product safety and technical regulations and any other relevant laws in the applicable jurisdiction(s) to which the products offered for sale are subject, products that are unsuitable for online sale or marketing, and/or products whose market sale has been suspended or prohibited, shall be deactivated within a maximum of 24 hours upon detection. This timeframe is determined by considering potential health risks to customers and the periods prescribed under the relevant legislation.

Sellers offering these products for sale are required to keep all relevant product safety information, necessary tests, and documentation regarding product compliance accessible and ready to be presented upon request. If the necessary information and documents are reviewed and accepted by Trendyol and demonstrate  that the products comply with the applicable legislation or do not fall within the scope of products prohibited from being placed on the market, the products may be reactivated.

IV. SUPPORTING COMPLIANCE WITH TRENDYOL QUALITY STANDARDS
To ensure compliance with Trendyol Quality Standards, we provide our business partners with supportive trainings, practices to increase competition within the platform, and access to sales-enhancing data related to their categories.

This approach helps sellers not only to improve their quality standards but also to understand which products are most preferred by customers, in line with relevant regulations. High-performing sellers are encouraged to share their experiences with others, creating a collaborative environment for learning and growth. Our aim is to enhance the quality, service, and pricing performance of our sellers, and to achieve the best results that will increase customer satisfaction.
A. Education Support
Our business partners receive continuous trainings and training-oriented events throughTrendyol to stay informed about applications and advancements in the e-commerce industry.This ongoing education contributes to both their professional growth and  enhances their e-commerce experience within Trendyol.

Trendyol Academy Trainings

Trendyol Academy is a training platform where our business partners can access trainings on all topics they may need to improve all their e-commerce processes, also related to EU Consumer Protection Laws. You can access our training catalog, where new trainings are constantly added, from Trendyol Academy. In our catalog, there are more than 500 trainings listed under important topics ranging from business strategy development tips to technical information on platform usage. The trainings are supported by live broadcasts, animations, videos and easy-to-follow guides. Partners can attend live trainings by following the Trendyol training calendar. Please note that Sellers must read the EU Consumer Protection Law Guidelines for Sellers Selling to EU.

Information Center

The "Information Center", placed within the Academy, serves as a comprehensive resource where our business partners can find answers about their operation at Trendyol in a single, accessible platform. This extensive digital e-commerce library includes video and visual guides, enabling our sellers to quickly and easily access relevant information. In addition, many of the Information Center's topics are open to all interested parties, i.e. the general public; stakeholders can also benefit from the Information Center when they search for information about Trendyol through search engines.

B. Application Support
Our technological infrastructure and services are designed for our business partners to manage their activities in the most comfortable and fastest way and are dedicated to their own use.

Seller Center

It is a special digital panel for our sellers where all operations within Trendyol can be managed from a single center. Through the Seller Center, including but not limited to the following;
● You can upload your products. You can set the selling prices of your products.
● You can track your orders.
● You can see the lead time of your pending orders.
● You can track important reports ( bestsellers, favorites, etc.).
● You can be promptly informed about the updates.
● You can manage your store.
● You can define a coupon.
● You can participate in Trendyol campaigns.
● You can create your own campaign.
● You can answer customer questions.
● You can send your questions, requests and suggestions via the support button.
● You can upload the documents requested from you via the "Document Transactions" screen.
● You can define and protect your trademark on the Document Operations screen.
In order not to cause high customer complaints, the number of daily order cancellations that can be made through the seller panel is limited to a certain number. The seller who wants to cancel above this limit can perform the cancellation process by using Trendyol seller support services.

If a seller account has not logged into the seller center for more than 10 days and the Seller is not managing its account with a partnered integrator company, and also seller has not processed any orders during this period, the seller account will be automatically placed in “vacation” mode. This action is taken to prevent potential customer dissatisfaction and ensure the seller can meet its legal obligations by avoiding supply chain disruptions. Before being placed in vacation mode, as a precaution,  a 5-day grace period (not less than 3 business days) is provided for the seller to log into the seller center. If the seller fails to log in within the given timeframe, the vacation mode is automatically activated.

Store Management

With the Store design segment in the seller center, , our business partners were enabled to improve their marketing activities. Our sellers can increase their sales capabilities by creating their own stores.
● There is a template prepared by Trendyol for the seller store.
● Using this template, sellers can choose their store logo, cover image and shading for the cover image.
● By installing banners in the store, they can redirect to product pages and boutiques.
● Using Trendyol features, they can categorize their products under different headings and highlight them in their stores in this way.
● They can create drafts for their designs and save these drafts without publishing them to the client.
● They can preview the store before taking it live.
Detailed information about Store Management can be found in Appendix 1.4 [Trendyol Seller Store Policies of Use].

Coupon Identification

Our sellers can create coupon campaigns by defining coupons for the customers they have identified in order to market their products and increase their sales. Points to be considered regarding the use/create of coupons are given below:
The types of coupons that can be created in the Seller Panel are Earn from Product, Special Target Audience, Earn Followers and Comment and Earn coupons.

Earn from Product and Special Target Audience coupons can be defined as valid for at least 1 day and maximum 7 days, Earn Followers coupons for minimum 1 day and maximum 30 days, and Comment and Earn Coupon can be defined for minimum 15 days and maximum 25 days.

Campaign Participation and Discounts

Defining campaigns and participating in campaigns organized by Trendyol is entirely the commercial choice of our sellers and our sellers are not obliged to define or participate in any campaigns. Sellers who wish to participate in a campaign are required to comply with the terms of the campaign. In addition,  Sellers may also create campaigns for their products, the terms of which are determined by them. The discounts offered must comply with the applicable legislation, including but not limited to the Omnibus Directive, and represent genuine price reductions in accordance with it.
● Trendyol campaigns can be accessed from the "Campaign & Price" tab on the Promotions page in the Seller Panel. By clicking on the campaign name, the campaign conditions of participation will also be displayed.
● Sellers who meet these conditions may add products to  a campaign through the "Campaign Products" tab on the same page.
● From the start date of a campaign, the price specified by the seller is automatically fixed in order to prevent misleading customers. Product price cannot be increased during the campaign. In order to increase the price, it is necessary to exit the relevant campaign. However, an extra discount on the product price can be made within the campaign process through the Seller Panel or integration application.
● When our sellers want to create a campaign for their products, they can set their discounts from the "Create Discount" section on the Promotion & Price page.
● If there is more than one discount defined for a product, discounts can be applied together.
● The discounts created by the seller can be canceled or edited at any time from the "Create Discount" section on the Promotions page.
● The discount generated by the seller affects the amount for which the product is purchased. The Seller shall deduct the progress payment for orders with discount campaigns on the day of payment with the discount reflected.
● If the customer cancels or returns a product with a discount defined on it, a refund will be made to the seller for the amount of the purchase.
● For orders where more than one product must be purchased for the discount to be valid, if the customer returns or cancels some of the products, the discount on the returned/canceled product will be refunded to the seller.

Product Commission Tariffs

The Product Commission Tariffs page shows the commission rates for different price ranges. Regardless of which screen our sellers' prices change from, the commission rates on this page will be applied according to the price range it corresponds to.
●   The page does not include all products, but only those selected according to a specific algorithm.
●   The price to which the commissions are applied is the single product sale price that customers see on the front side, net of Trendyol Paid Campaigns. Vouchers, discounts for multiple purchases and promotions with a threshold do not affect the relevant price range.
●   When our sellers bring their prices to different price ranges created for the products, they can make their sales at the commission price determined for the relevant range. If this commission fee is higher than the fee arising from the seller's other agreements, the other agreements remain valid.
●   Our sellers can access the Product Commission Tariffs page from the Promotion & Price tab in the Seller Center.

Tag (Badge) Description

Trendyol uses labels to characterize the performance of a seller or a product. The rules for issuing a label to a seller or product are common to all products and sellers, and all sellers and products that meet the necessary conditions can be issued these labels. Tags are removed if the seller/product fails to meet the relevant conditions. Below you can find detailed information about the seller/product labels applied on Trendyol.
Product Labels
i. Discount Product Label
There are three different advantageous product labels, in order of price ranges from least to most: Discount, Super Discount, Mega Discount Product Label.
The price at which discount label is applied is the individual product sale price that customers see on the front side.
ii.  Advantageous Product Badge
There are three different advantageous product labels, ranked from lowest to highest based on price ranges: Super Discount Badge, Mega Discount Badge, and Hyper Discount Badge.

The price to which the Advantageous Product Labels apply is the individual product sale price visible to customers on the product detail page.
These labels are calculated through a specific algorithm that takes into account the product's sales performance, listing prices, and/or discount rates on Trendyol during a defined period.
Any price updates made by sellers through the available price update screens will affect the eligible price used for determining whether the product qualifies for an Advantageous Product Label.
iii. Verified Seller
Official sellers or civil society organizations of brands that are highly recognized in Turkiye or internationally and are trusted on the platform are awarded the “Verified Seller (Blue Tick)” badge.
For a seller to receive the “Verified Seller (Blue Tick)” badge, they must meet all of the following criteria:

Listing at least 1 product in the last month
The seller must prove that they are the owner of the brand, or

the sole and final authorized seller of the brand, or
even if they are not the sole and final authorized seller of the brand, they must be one of the brands specified according to their own brand rules and have the specified number of offline stores

The seller's average seller rating over the last month must never have fallen below 7.50 (the seller rating criterion is not considered during the period when the seller's rating has not yet been calculated)
The violation score must be kept below 12 points
The seller must have a store opened with the relevant brand (which may also include region + authority + category)

Vacation Mode

Vacation Mode is developed for our sellers who want to take a break from Trendyol operation. Our sellers who take a break from selling on Trendyol on their own initiative should go into Vacation Mode and stop their operations. Our sellers who want to take a break from their operation,
●   Reset product stocks and prices
●   Put their accounts on vacation mode
●   You must complete the operational processes of your pending orders(You must deliver your orders to the cargo within the deadline, cancel orders that you cannot supply.

When our sellers do not fulfill the above steps, they will be held responsible for the relevant Platform Rules as an active seller, as they will appear to be actively selling in the system. On the other hand, even if a seller places itself in Vacation Mode, it will be treated as an active seller until it ships its most recent order received prior to such placement and will be subject to all responsibilities arising from such order in the same manner as an active seller.
The payments of our sellers who switch to Vacation Mode will be made in the same order as active sellers in the relevant term and payment period.
Additionally,
· Holiday Mode is applied to sellers whose operational capacity status is Red or Orange and who cannot be reached via their approved electronic communication addresses for 3 business days despite notifications being sent; during this period, their shipping performance remains below 20% of their current capacity. Sellers placed in Vacation Mode can exit Vacation Mode by completing the necessary steps via the seller panel without opening any notifications.
· Under the abuse rule set, sellers with more than 1,000 cancellable orders and a sales uplift exceeding 5 times their sales performance over the last 4 weeks will be notified via their approved electronic communication addresses. If it is determined that these sellers continue to sell defective products despite this notification, the seller account will be placed in Vacation Mode until the necessary actions are clarified and implemented. A seller placed in Vacation Mode can exit Vacation Mode by completing the necessary procedures via the seller panel without opening any notifications.

If a seller continues to accept orders exceeding their current delivery and shipping capacity despite their operational capacity status being Red, their seller account will be placed in Vacation Mode to manage operational risk and maintain service quality. Vacation Mode is a risk management mechanism that temporarily suspends order acceptance to ensure the seller returns to a level compatible with their operational capacity and can meet the promised service standards. Vacation Mode continues until the seller's operational capacity status returns to Green. The thresholds for capacity overages and the level of risk are assessed and applied within the framework of rules sets determined by TrendyolDSM, taking into account the seller's operational volume, capacity size, and historical performance data.

Customer Questions

Product Questions
Our sellers can increase sales and reduce return rates by answering product questions (material, size, brand, model, etc.) submitted by customers. The Customer Questions feature aims to improve the shopping experience by bringing the seller and the customer together and allows the seller to learn and answer the details that customers are curious about their product. In this way, sellers can enrich their product descriptions and customers can access the details they are curious about the product through the seller's previous answers. In this respect, if sellers respond to product questions quickly and in accordance with the rules, it may have a positive impact on product content quality and sales performance.

Handling Time

If there are multiple products in the same order and the deadlines of these products are different, the order is created according to the deadline of the product with the lowest deadline. In such orders, the Seller may divide the package and ship each product according to the deadline defined for the product.
Sellers can change their current deadlines within the minimum and maximum deadline ranges specified in the Deadline Settings screen on the seller dashboard. The current deadline set on this screen applies to all products, except for products labeled as express delivery or ship today and products with barcode-based deadlines.
Sellers can define deadlines for each barcode separately, provided that they are between minimum and maximum values, changing the current deadline does not affect the barcode-based deadline definition.

Category Tree

Listing the products under the right categories is important so that customers looking for the relevant product can meet the product. For this reason, Trendyol offers a rich category tree so that the products can be listed in the most compatible categories with their purposes and names. While creating the category tree, the words that customers search for, and their Seller needs are evaluated together. In this respect, improvements and developments can be made in the category tree from time to time, and categories that are found to be difficult to search because they include more than one product group can be closed, while new categories can be created, or the name of an existing category can be changed. When it comes to closing a category during these developments, if there is a more correct category but there are products listed and sold in this category, these products are passed to the correct categories by the category teams. In terms of these products, sellers can continue to sell subject to the commission rate of the correct category in which their products were migrated. If a category is closed, the sellers are asked to delete the products within the given time for the products in this category that have never been sold; otherwise, Trendyol informs that the products will be removed from sale. Sellers who delete/remove their products in the closed category can easily re-open these products for sale from the correct categories.

Brand Registration Management in the Category Tree

If it is determined that a brand is used or intended to be used for products in a number of main categories exceeding the limit set by Trendyol (e.g., shoes, garden products, automotive parts, etc.) is detected or intended to be used (such as selling both high-heeled shoes and gel batteries under the same brand), the products listed under the relevant brand will be temporarily locked to prevent misuse of the brand and incorrect brand entries.
In this case, if any seller listing the relevant products proves that the brand is registered in any class of goods or services, all products under the categories associated with the classes covered by the registration will be reopened for sale to all sellers.

For the avoidance of doubt, until the trademark registration is proven in the goods and services classes corresponding to the category in which the relevant products are listed, the products may continue to be listed under the heading “General Brands.”

Customer Cancellation After Creating an Invoice

Customers can cancel their products in Trendyol orders until the relevant order is delivered to the cargo by the seller; in this respect, orders in Trendyol are open to customer cancellation until they are transferred to cargo delivery status. However
1. Orders of sellers working with The Supplier Pays Program (Program 1) model with cargo companies that do not have cargo integration are closed to customer cancellation in the "invoiced" status. Sellers can access the current list of cargo companies without cargo integration via "Seller Support Services". If required by their operational processes, sellers may request to close to customer cancellation "after the order invoice is generated" (before the order is delivered to cargo). In order for the seller's cancellation status to be adjusted accordingly, the time between invoicing date and shipment date must be equal to or shorter than the targeted value for orders received in the last 2 months. It is required to feed the invoiced status to Trendyol via integration. Sellers who do not achieve the required performance on a monthly basis will be opened to customer cancellation.
For orders that are closed to customer cancellation in the "Invoiced" status and have not yet entered the "in transit" status, if the customer requests cancellation, at the end of 3 business days from the date of the request, the order status will be reflected in the system as "customer cancellation".

Under Threshold Support Application

When sellers working with the Trendyol Pays Program (Program 2) send packages below threshold , shipping is charged at the fixed shipping rates shared on the panel instead of the deci based prices shared on the panel.
For a shipment to be eligible for below-scale shipping rates;
-  Feeding the deci information by the cargo company at 10 deci and below
-  Shipping with standard cargo companies (logistics company or standard cargo companies not included in the price list are not included in the application)
-  Reshipment, exchange, reshipment, no reshipment package of missing product
-  If the package is formed after a split, the initial order value must be below the threshold (only one of the formed packages is subject to the threshold support application).
Return packages are not included in the below-scale application. Only sellers working with the Trendyol Pays Program (Program 2) model and platform tier with a successful seller badge can benefit from below-bar support for return packages while they have a successful seller badge.

Handling  and Estimated Delivery Time Displays

Depending on the seller's current deadline or the deadline defined on the barcode, the customer will be shown the deadline on the product detail pages. After the order is placed, the estimated delivery date is shown on the My Orders screen until the order is in "shipped/in transit" status.
After the order is shipped, the customer is shown the estimated delivery date. This date is calculated at the time the order is shipped and may vary depending on the shipping company.

Additional Shipping Charges

In cases where Trendyol Pays Program (Program 2) model is used, the invoices made by the carrier companies regarding the additional costs incurred for the relevant shipment are reflected to the seller. (Package splitting, Heavy transport, Package transported outside the delivery zones, additional diesel costs, etc.)

Deci Information Flow and Applications

In cases where Trendyol Pays Program (Program 2) is in operation, desi-based pricing is made according to the desi information fed by the carrier companies. For packages without desi information flow, the average desi information of the packages sent by the seller via Trendyol is used for pricing and the average desi information is updated regularly. Sellers can access the relevant desi information on the panel and request an objection or re-evaluation. If the request complies with the rules specified in the panel and trainings, it is forwarded to the cargo company and the positive / negative return from the cargo is shared with the seller via the panel. Trendyol can also make desi objections to cargo companies on behalf of the seller, and the results are shared with the seller on the seller center.

In the Seller Pays Program (Program 1) model, there is no information flow for the packets formed. Cargo billing, displaying deci information on the panel and objection transactions are not performed.

Category Based Customer Daily Purchase Limits

On the product detail page, visible to customers, there are purchase limits set by Trendyol for each product in that category, indicating the maximum number of purchases per day for a customer in a single order. These limits are intended to prevent the seller from unexpectedly receiving large orders and being unable to supply.

Micro Exportation

With the micro exportation method, our sellers can receive orders from abroad and ship the orders they receive. The rules that will be valid for the sellers using the application are detailed in Annex 1.9 [Rules for Sending Products Abroad via Micro Export].

B. Monitoring and Analysis Support
With the applications we develop, we aim to increase transparency and provide more useful data to our sellers. Thanks to applications such as Buy Box and Reports Screen, our business partners can be easily and quickly informed about their position and what they need to do to increase their sales performance, and thus determine their commercial strategies accurately, quickly and easily.

Reports Screen

Our sellers can see sales-enhancing data about themselves, customer comments, favorite and viewed products, conversion rates of their products to shopping and bestsellers in their categories in separate reports on the Reports Screen. In this context, sales, cancellation, return, campaign and operation reports can be tracked on product, brand and category basis via the Reports Screen.
Product reviews by customers, seller reviews can also be accessed from the "My Reviews" tab on the Reports Screen.
In the "Sales Enhancer" tab on the Reports Screen, the issues that are recommended to be improved according to the performance metrics of our sellers are included. In this section, which includes completely seller-specific suggestions, suggestions on important issues that can be directly acted upon by the seller are listed (products that are about to sell out, products that are sold out, questions that customers are waiting for answers, products with low sales despite high visits, products with low visits despite high sales, products that receive no visits, products with low visits and low sales, products with high visits and high sales, products that receive many questions, products with insufficient product content, etc.).

Buy Box

With the Buy Box application, sellers selling the same product are grouped under a single heading, making it easier for sellers to reach customers and for customers to reach sellers and products. In Buy Box's ranking application, the seller that is judged to provide the best experience to our customers both during and after shopping is ranked first. In this context, the most important criterion that a seller needs to meet in order to rank first on Buy Box is the Trendyol selling price for the product. Along with the price, other factors that will affect the total cost of the product for the customer are also taken into account (availability of free shipping, impact of simultaneous campaigns on the price, etc.). The other two most important criteria are the the seller's commitment to fast delivery. Apart from these criteria, criteria that show the seller's performance regarding the relevant product (speed of response to incoming customer inquiries, customer evaluation scores about the product, availability of content enriching elements such as videos in the product, etc.) can also be taken into account. Our sellers can see the winning BuyBox prices on their Seller Center. As the Buy Box winning price changes, the price information is updated instantly by the system.  In addition, the visibility of your product will be affected depending on whether your operation status is orange or red, so these statuses will naturally affect the buybox ranking.

Algorithm Criteria (Parameters) in Product Ranking

Algorithm Criteria that Determining Visibility and Prioritisation in Home Page Display
● Past user movements of the product (number of views, number of clicks, number of purchases, etc.)
● Likelihood of user purchase (User Segment, similarity rates of users)
● Seller Operational Metrics (Number and Rate of Returns, Number of Failure to Supply, etc.)
● User Reviews (Seller Reviews, Product Reviews, Customer Complaints)
● Banner Performance Metrics (past performance of products, sales forecast of products, campaign information, etc.) ***Banners are the components on the homepage that redirect to pages such as boutique, search, etc.
Algorithm Criteria for Determining Visibility and Prioritisation on the Page
● Keyword/search result entered by the customer in the search bar (whether there is a gender-based search term, number of category filter uses, category-based click-through data, relevance between the search term and product information)
● Past user movements of the product (number of views, number of clicks, number of purchases, etc.)
● Product historical price information
● Customer Comments and Reviews (Number of comments, comment content, number of reviews, number of reviews, review scores, number of reviews with photos, photos in reviews)
● Likelihood of user purchase (User Segment, similarity rates of users)
● The user's movements on the Platform (products viewed in the same session, products purchased after browsing in the same session, products viewed by the user, etc.)
● Relationship rate between products (Product information, name, image, etc. and product past user actions)
● Complementarity rate between products (product information and product past user actions)
● Ad Information (cost per click, ad Budget, etc.) and Ad-related Action Data (number of clicks, views, purchases of the ad product)
Other Algorithm Criteria to Consider in Ranking
● User Demographic Information (Gender, Age, Address, etc.)
● Movements of Users Similar to the User on the Platform (number of purchases made on the Platform to date, shopping amount, payment method, number of returns, being an influencer/elite/new/active member, prices of category-based products, membership date, application platform used, time elapsed since product actions, categories/brands of products purchased/reviewed/favorited, etc.).
● Which channel the user came from outside the platform, which ad they clicked on
● Collection Information (Owner, Date Created/Updated, products, video information, number of followers, stock information, number of products, frequency of updates, user segment, star/comment/image quality/title information/star attribute/sales numbers etc. features of the products in the collection) **Users can assign the products they choose to lists called collections as if they were favorites. For example, you can open a collection called winter clothing and fill it, similarly, influencers can choose products and create a collection. The contents of these collections influence the sorting algorithms.
● Product Information (Name, Description, Image, Gender, Age Group, Size, Price, Category, Brand, Seller, Product Features-attribute, Stock Status, Release Date, etc.) **It refers to the changes in the ranking according to the search made due to the filtering of the customer and if the seller enters this information correctly and completely. These features can also be used to group and compare products.
● Product Campaign Information (Price discount, product badges, cart discount, whether there is a defined coupon, coupon limit and amount, shipping price, delivery time, etc.)
● Past Sales Data of the product can be defined as the changes seen in the sales of the product and the status of these changes according to the current sales information.
● Complaints from Customers about the Product (Excessive price, faulty content, etc.)
● User Reviews (Seller Reviews, Product Reviews, Customer Complaints, Q&A time to answer the question, etc.)
● Number of Seller Store Followers, Seller Coupon Information, Seller's Panel Usage, Whether the seller has defined / not defined coupons, The amount of coupons defined (10 EUR etc.) and the number (5 pieces), Whether the defined coupons are scaled or not, If scaled, how much the scale is, etc. information.
● User History (Number of purchases made on the platform to date, shopping amount, payment method, number of returns, being an influencer/elite/new/active member, prices of category-based products, membership date, application platform used, time elapsed since product actions, etc.).
● Likelihood of User Purchase (based on Category, Brand and Product), User Segment, Users' similarity rates, Seller Score, Comment Ranking Score,
● Ad Product Action Data (number of clicks, views, purchases, data on the number of times the ad product was viewed, purchased, added to cart, etc.)
● Search term-based user actions (Filters used in the related search and their usage, number of times products/sellers are displayed in the related search, number of times products/sellers are displayed in the related search (clicks), similarity rate between the related search term and product/seller names)"
● User Behaviors (Viewing/clicking/favoriting/saving/sharing collections, viewing/clicking/favoriting/adding to cart/purchasing products within the collection, etc.)
● Influencer Information (Number of Followers, Audience, Content, etc.)
● Influencer Popularity Information (segmented by number of followers on other platforms)
● Video Information (Owner, Date Created, etc.)

D. Communication Support
We see the strength of communication between our business partners and Trendyol and its customers as an indispensable element of cooperation. In this context, our business partners must be both accessible to Trendyol customers and able to maintain effective mutual communication with Trendyol. The services we provide to meet communication-specific standards are continuously developed in line with the needs of our partners and customers.

Seller Support

The Seller Support team is the team that supports you for your problems, requests and suggestions. You can get support via the "Seller Assistant" tab in your Seller Center.
It is aimed to respond to the notifications you create through the support lines as soon as possible. It is important to create a request with the right title so that you receive a response within the targeted turnaround time.

Ensuring the Accessibility of Sellers

In accordance with the current legislation, sellers are required to enter their relevant legal and business information into the system as described in the Agreement.
It is obligatory for our sellers to enter the information within the scope of the legislation into the system in full before starting sales on our platform and to make updates regarding changes in this information, if any, on the day of the change. In this respect, the responsibility will belong to the seller as a result of not entering the information required to be entered by the seller in accordance with the relevant legislation, entering incomplete or incorrect information and/or not updating it on time. Our sellers can access their information in the system from the Account Information screen in the Seller Center, complete the deficiencies and make updates; they can also benefit from live support lines.

ANNEX 1.1: PRODUCTS NOT SUITABLE FOR SALE ON TRENDYOL
The sale of the products listed below through Trendyol is not permitted in order to comply with the provisions of the applicable legislation.
If your upload of a product to the Trendyol platform has been rejected by our quality control teams due to violations of the platform rules, please carefully review the list below.
Products that have been flagged for non-compliance with the below categories may only be resubmitted for sale if corrective actions are taken, such as adjusting product images, removing misleading claims, or providing required documentation. Sellers may request product reinstatement only after these conditions are met. Products Violating Platform Rules
Products violating platform rules include but not limited to:
● Prohibited and Offensive Products: The sale of products that support or promote organizations associated with terrorism, criminal activities, or hate groups, or that display emblems of such organizations, is strictly prohibited. Products that insult national, moral, or religious values, or contain content that discriminates based on ethnicity, nationality, religion, politics, or culture, or that incites social division and conflict, are also banned.

Products with Violent or Harmful Content: The sale of products containing images or text that insult, demean, or promote violence against individuals, groups, or animals is forbidden. In line with standards protecting children and young people, products that depict or promote violent behavior, substance abuse, or self-harm are strictly prohibited.

Inappropriate Content for Minors: Product images that may be considered as exposing child bodies inappropriately or promoting unsafe or adult themes to minors are not allowed. For this reason, not using live mannequins in children's clothing products will ensure that your products can be easily approved.

Sexually Explicit Content: Obscene or sexually explicit product images or descriptions that may be deemed inappropriate for family viewing are prohibited.

Animal-Derived Products and Wildlife: The sale of fur products derived from animals raised in fur farms (e.g., fox, rex, astrakhan, mink) or exotic animal skins (e.g., snake, crocodile, foal) is prohibited. Products involving endangered species or protected wildlife, or those that do not adhere to applicable animal protection laws, are also restricted.

Animal Testing Compliance: The sale of cosmetic products tested on animals is restricted in jurisdictions where animal testing is banned. All products must comply with applicable animal testing regulations.

Products Intended to Harm Animals: Products explicitly designed to harm or repel animals, including harmful deterrents, are not allowed.

Unauthorized Health Devices and Supplements: The sale of unauthorized medical devices or health-related products that lack regulatory approval is prohibited. This includes dietary supplements containing banned or unapproved ingredients.

Unsafe or Hazardous Products: Products must comply with relevant safety certifications, especially for items intended for children, such as toys, electronics, and furniture. Products containing restricted or hazardous substances, as regulated under REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorization, and Restriction of Chemicals), are not permitted.

Counterfeit and Misleading Products: All product images, descriptions, and claims must be accurate and must not mislead consumers. Sellers are prohibited from uploading counterfeit or inauthentic products or making false claims that could deceive consumers about the product’s safety, efficacy, or origin.

(Authorization certificate is not required for the sale of handheld/garden type tools).
● Products Hazardous to Human Health / Carcinogenic Substances

● Airbag and Equipment
