ANNEX 1.2: TRENDYOL  PRODUCT LISTING RULES
I.   Tracking Product Statuses and Necessary Actions to be Taken
After logging in your products on TRENDYOL , all your products and their publication status are available in the "Product" tab on the Seller Panel.
A.   On Sale
Products that have passed through the product approval process and whose price & stock information is different from zero are shown in this field.
1.   In order for the products to be offered for sale, stock and price information must be entered and must have passed the approval processes.
2.   Products without price and stock information are not opened for sale. Products with incorrect price information or insufficient stock may be closed for sale to protect our sellers and customers.
B.   Out of Stock
This tab contains products that were previously on sale but are now out of stock. Stock information must be updated for the products to be available for sale again. Products with outdated stock information remain closed for sale. Products with updated stock information other than zero do not enter the rechecking process and are displayed in the "On Sale" tab.
C.   What You Need to Revise
This section includes products rejected for content quality and content compatibility during the product approval process. Once the relevant products have been updated correctly, they are included in the approval process again. If it complies with TRENDYOL  Platform standards, it is put up for sale.
The reasons for rejection of the product are as follows.
Visual Quality:
1.   You should set a standard size when adding product images to TRENDYOL.com.
2.   You should prepare product images with a minimum size of 600 x 800.
3.   You should use a minimum resolution of 72 dpi for images for the web environment.
4.   Small images should not be used as they cannot show detailed product information.
5.   You should make sure that the maximum image size is 10MB.
6.   The images used for the product must be the same size/color/brand as the product. Products that do not meet the brand/size/color criteria in the image will not be opened for sale.
7.   Images used for the product should be selected from anonymous images taken by the brand/seller or publicly available. In case of unauthorized use of images taken by someone else, the products will not be opened for sale and TRENDYOL  will suspend the sale of the products for a period / indefinitely due to unauthorized use of images.
8.   In case of using racist and exclusionary symbols/phrases that humiliate, hurt, insult people/societies and communities in product images or descriptions; using symbols/phrases that are harmful to health, harm/encourage harm to the body integrity of the person; using symbols/phrases with sexual content, the products will not be opened for sale, and the products found to be opened for sale will be immediately removed from the publication indefinitely.
9.   There should be no health declaration in the images.
10. The product will be rejected if it is listed in a different brand and out of the category in which the product should be. Publishing the product with this behavior, which is against the rules of the platform, requires receiving violation points.
11. The publication of images that expose the child's body is refused. You can use a mannequin.
Content Adequacy and Quality:
1.   Product content consists of product features and usage details.
2.   Product content should include information where the customer can see the details of product use and product content.
3.   For electronic products, warranty conditions and installation service information should be included in the product content information.
4.   Products whose product content information does not comply with the rules or does not contain the information legally required to be disclosed are moved to the heading that needs to be revised.
5.   When you update the visual and content of your products rejected for the above reasons, your products can be included in the approval process. However, if the reason for the rejection of your product is that it is a prohibited product for sale on the internet or on the platform, this product will not be allowed to be published.
D.  Not for Sale
This section includes products that are awaiting approval and products that have been approved but have not yet been put up for sale because their price & stock information is 0.
E.   Locked Products
This section includes products that have been withdrawn due to the following 2 main headings.
1.   Violation of TRENDYOL  platform rules and competent authority decisions
2.   Operational inefficiency
You can find out the reason why your product is closed for sale, and if there is anything that needs to be done to open it for sale, you can learn this information from the reason for the closure of the relevant product and the "What should I do" section on the screens.
F.   Archived Products
This section contains products that you have withdrawn to the archive on the grounds that you will not sell them. If you want, you can remove the products from the archive and put them back on sale by entering price and stock information. If the products in this area are to be put back on sale, they will not enter the approval process again because they have already been approved.
II.  Product Listing Limits
Since it is not possible for sellers to upload an unlimited number of products to the platform, each level of seller has an upper limit of product listings depending on the seller level. The higher the seller level, the higher the seller's listing limits. However, even if the seller's level drops, in no case will the maximum number of listings fall below the basic initial limit. This basic starting limit is calculated based on the average number of product listings per store on TRENDYOL  and is above average. In this respect, the limits will not affect the sales capacity of any seller. The aim of the limitation is to ensure that the product search infrastructure works better, traffic is used more efficiently, and the highest benefit is achieved for customers and sellers by removing products that are randomly uploaded, may have content quality violations, make quality control difficult, affect traffic flow even though they have not been sold for a long time, and are not preferred by the customer in the benefit-price balance. The relevant rules are given below:
A.   Listing Limitation Criteria
1.   Seller's limit is determined by its level (the level the Seller sees in the Seller Center).
2.   The system is run weekly for seller limits.
3.   Level changes;
-  For those who move to the next higher level, the new limits are reflected in the weekly employee schedule on the day of detection.
-  For sellers who are found to have moved to the lower level in the weekly running program are informed and 28 days are given to rearrange their products. At the end of 28 days, if the sellers’ products are more than the new limit assigned according to the current level in quantity, an additional 2 days is given and has been notified. If the seller does not take action within this additinonal period, the products will be deleted by TRENDYOL  according to the "Deletion of Products Exceeding the Limits Determined by Seller Level" rule set.
B.   Deletion of Products Above the Limits Determined by Seller Level
1.   TRENDYOL  makes product selection by looking at the being in archive, sales and viewing data of the products, and prioritizes and deletes the products in the following order.
In whichever the Seller's excess product quantity falls to the Seller's limit during this process, the deletion process is stopped at that step and the product.
a. Archived for more than 1 year  (for the product prioritization within this criterion, the upload dates of the products to the system are effective. The deletion process starts from the old products to the new products.)
b. Products that have not been viewed for more than 1 year, have not been sold and have been on the platform for more than 2 years (products that do not have stock or price in products that meet this criterion are prioritized, then the products for which stock and price are entered are checked. The prioritization of each group is based on the number of sales of the products in previous years. In case the sales quantities of the products are the same, the products are sorted according to their opening dates.)
c. Products that have not been viewed for more than 1 year, have not been seen for sale and have been on the platform for more than 1 year (products that do not have stock or price among the products that meet this criterion are prioritized, then the products for which stock and price are entered are checked. The prioritization within each group is based on the number of sales of the products in previous years.In case the sales quantities of the products are the same, the products are sorted according to their opening dates.)
d. Products that have not been viewed for more than 1 year, have not seen sales and have been opened within the last 1 year (products that do not have stock or price among the products that meet this criterion are prioritized, then the products whose stock and price are entered are checked. For product prioritization within both groups, the products are uploaded to the system dates become effective. Deletion process starts from old products to new products.)
2.   The seller is notified 28+2 days before TRENDYOL  deletes the seller's products that are over the upper limit of product listing. If the seller does not take action, the products will be deleted after 28+2 days in accordance with the rules set by TRENDYOL .
3.   The deletion is applied for products to be sold in Turkey and through micro-exports. FBT products (products added for sale abroad) are not included.
4.   If the seller, who is found to have passed the lower level, rises to the previous level or to a higher level within 28 days, the limit is determined again that day and TRENDYOL  does not take any action on the seller's products, the products are not deleted. The seller's limit is either not lowered or a new increased limit is assigned.
5.   If the seller who has been identified as downgraded has experienced multiple downgrades at the end of the 28-day period given to the seller to organize its products, the limit of the level at the end of the period is defined. Example: It is seen that the seller has dropped from Level 5 to Level 4. --> The Seller is notified and asked to reorganize his/her products within 28 + 2 days --> At the end of 28 days, the Seller’s level information is checked again and the new limit corresponding to his/her current level is defined. --> If the seller's level drops again and becomes Level 3, the limit corresponding to Level 3 is defined and the seller is given an additional 2 days to arrange the products that are above the new limit in quantity.

C. Deleting Archived Products Remaining within the Limits Determined by Seller Level
Products that are within the Seller's product listing limits but have been in the archive for the last 1.5 years or more will be automatically deleted.
ANNEX 1.3: TRENDYOL  CUSTOMER QUESTIONS FEATURE USAGE RULES
TRENDYOL  customer questions feature is a feature that allows customers to send detailed questions about the product or order to the sellers
The questions of our customers who ask product questions using this feature should be answered from Product > Product Questions on the seller centerl, and the questions of our customers who ask order questions should be answered from Order & Shipping > Order Questions on the seller center.
The use and rules of the TRENDYOL  'Customer Questions' feature are determined by TRENDYOL  and announced to the sellers.
Customer questions features:
●   Customers can send their questions about the product and their orders to the sellers through this feature.
●   Sellers' responses are communicated to customers through the seller central and via e-mail.
●   The answers given by sellers to product questions are published for all to see the question and answer. If the question contains a word or health statement that may be related to the order, questions that are repetitive and/or require subjective evaluation, the question and answer are set so that only the customer can see it. The visibility of the answers given by the seller to order questions is set so that only the customer can see the question and answer.
●   A "Report Issue" button has been created for sellers to report the content of the questions they are uncomfortable with to TRENDYOL . In the event that the questions from the customer include statements that violate the personal rights of the sellers, are not in accordance with the general rules of morality and ethics, contain swearing/slang, contain political/political statements, contain any ethnic origin, language, religion, race, sexual orientation or humiliate them, TRENDYOL  should be notified by using the "Report a Problem" button. In these cases, the question will be rejected and no answer will be required.

Rules to follow when answering customer questions:

1.   Provisional answers should not be given. (Example: We will return shortly, we will investigate and return) Violation points can be reflected to the seller who stops the counter by refraining from answering questions with printed and unrelated answers, without giving a printed and unrelated answer within the scope of the "good trade system".
2.   The seller must only answer questions about the product and the order. In the event that the questions received from the customer contain expressions that violate the personal rights of the sellers, are not in accordance with the general rules of morality and ethics, contain profanity / slang, contain political / political statements, contain any ethnic origin, language, religion, race, sexual orientation or humiliate them, they should be reported to TRENDYOL  by the sellers via the "Report Problem" button for product questions and the "Complain" button for order questions.
3.   The "Report a Problem" button to be used by sellers must be used within 3 business days, which is the question response period.
4.   The answers created by the Seller cannot contain words and content that violate the personal rights of customers, are not in accordance with the general rules of morality and ethics, contain abusive / slang expressions and political / political messages for ages 18 and over, point out or humiliate any ethnic origin, language, religion, race, sexual orientation. In the event that responses containing such statements are complained by the customer or detected by TRENDYOL , the seller account will be temporarily suspended under the "Good Trading System". TRENDYOL  continuously scans the published questions and answers for banned words. Responses that violate personal rights, are not in compliance with general rules of morality and ethics, contain abusive/slang expressions and political/political messages that are 18 years of age or older, or contain words and content that indicate or denigrate any ethnic origin, language, religion, race, sexual orientation can be detected with this screening.
5.   Replies generated by the Seller cannot contain any advertising and contact information. Unless specifically requested by the customer, the seller's redirection to its own store, social media account, website, communication channels such as phone / e-mail may cause the seller to receive a violation score within the scope of the "Good Trading System".

ANNEX 1.4: TRENDYOL  SELLER STORE POLICIES OF USE
Seller Store is a feature that allows sellers to create their own branded stores within TRENDYOL  apps.
Accordingly, sellers will be able to create their own store screens, primarily on iOS and Android platforms. The platforms on which the Seller Store applications can be actively used are determined by TRENDYOL  and announced to the sellers.
Seller Store features:
●   There is a template prepared by TRENDYOL  for the Seller Store.
●   Using this template, sellers can choose their store logo, cover image and shading for the cover image.
●   By installing banners in the store, they can redirect to product pages and boutiques.
●   They can sort their products using TRENDYOL  features or highlight the product in their stores they want regardless of the features.
●   They can create drafts for their designs and save these drafts without publishing them to the client.
●   They can preview before going live.

Rules for TRENDYOL  sellers to follow when using these features:
1.   The logo and cover images uploaded to the Seller Store must comply with TRENDYOL 's visual guidelines that have been applied to date. Images with different brand/e-commerce site/model logos, images with inappropriate content that have been closed for internet sales or presented to 18+ age group do not comply with TRENDYOL 's image policy.
2.   Images consisting of content that violates the law and does not comply with TRENDYOL 's image policy may be removed by TRENDYOL .
3.   Sellers may use names, logos and cover images for their store names, logos and cover images that they own the intellectual and industrial property rights to or that are available for public use. If a name, logo, image that does not belong to the seller or without permission from the right holder (this also includes but is not limited to images which are owned and/or published by influencers on the internet) is used, the use of the seller's store will be suspended by TRENDYOL  until the content subject to the violation is corrected in order to put an end to the unlawfulness in case of a valid violation notice or unfair use is noticed by TRENDYOL.
4.   The banners installed in the store should only be directed to the products and boutiques in TRENDYOL  lists.
5.  The use of commercial titles such as ltd, sti, a.s., company, and expressions that direct to internet domain names like com.tr, net is prohibited in the store name.
6. Except for (&, "", ''), the use of conjunctions and special characters (e.g., parentheses, underscores, dashes, etc.) is prohibited in the store name.
7.   The use of a store name that has been previously used by another seller is prevented to ensure that there are not multiple instances of the same store name. Except for sellers who hold trademark rights, the usage of a store name that is already being used by another seller on the platform is restricted by the system.
8.   A store name can consist of a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 40 characters.
9.  Sellers cannot use expressions such as "authorized," "distributor," "dealer," which specify authority between the seller and the brand, in store names. If the accuracy of these expressions is confirmed by TRENDYOL  through documentation, the products or seller will be entitled to use the relevant labels.

The seller whose store usage is suspended will be notified by TRENDYOL  about the reason for the suspension. Once the problem is fixed, the store will be available again. Ex: Once the logo/cover/image/name that caused the trademark infringement is revised, the store can be reopened for use. However, if it is determined that the relevant name and logo are made for the purpose of open forgery, it will not be possible to use the store as a result of the revision, as the seller account will be closed.
ANNEX 1.6: SALES RESTRICTIONS TO BE APPLIED IN CASE OF VIOLATION OF TRENDYOL QUALITY STANDARDS
This annex outlines the measures Trendyol may take to ensure compliance with the following quality standards:
- Product Quality Standards: Ensuring Compliance with Product Quality Standards
- Operational Quality Standards: Ensuring Compliance with Operation Quality Standards

Under these headings, the restrictions that Trendyol will put into effect in case of violations of the criteria determined in line with the quality standards required by each heading and the details of which have been provided are included.
All quality standards are based on objective, transparent, and non-discriminatory criteria that apply equally across all Sellers. Performance metrics, such as return rates, supply failure rates, and delivery times, are calculated periodically to ensure fairness and consistency.
A. Restrictions on the Seller Account
In cases where Seller accounts do not meet operational standards, Trendyol may impose account restrictions to maintain customer satisfaction and operational integrity.

Reason for Account Closure

Details

Provision

Actions You Can Take

Good Trading System

Seller violation points reaches 12

After 7 days (not less than 3 business days) after the reflection of the score, the seller account will be suspended for 2 days.

If you exercise your right to appeal within the first 7 days after the point is reflected and your appeal is valid, your point will be deleted and no suspension action will be taken.

Good Trading System

Seller violation points reaches 24

After 7 days (not less than 3 business days) after the reflection of the score, the seller account will be suspended for 5 days.

If you exercise your right to appeal within the first 7 days after the point is reflected and your appeal is valid, your point will be deleted and no suspension action will be taken.

Good Trading System

Seller violation points reaches 36

After 7 days (not less than 3 business days) after the reflection of the score, the seller account will be suspended for 7 days.

If you exercise your right to appeal within the first 7 days after the point is reflected and your appeal is valid, your point will be deleted and no suspension action will be taken.

Good Trading System

Seller violation points reaches 48

7 days after the reflection of the score (not less than 3 working days) the seller account will be suspended indefinitely and after 30 days the contract will be terminated.

If you exercise your right to appeal within the first 7 days after the point is reflected and your appeal is valid, your point will be deleted and no suspension action will be taken.

Over the next 23 days

(i) If a valid objection is submitted, the suspension will be lifted.

(ii) If no objection is submitted or the submitted objection is invalid, your seller agreement will be terminated.

Good Trading System

After the score is reflected, the seller's account will be immediately suspended, and payments will be held for 3 months, unless a longer retention period is required by official institutions, authorities, court rulings, or regulatory decisions. 30 days after the score is reflected, the contract will be terminated.

If you exercise your right to object within the first 30 days after the score is reflected and your objection is deemed valid, the score will be removed, and the termination action will not take place. If you do not submit an objection or if your objection is not valid, your seller contract will be terminated 30 days after the score is reflected.

High Rate of Failure to Supply

Considering customer satisfaction, if your inability-to-supply rate (number of unsupplied products in orders received within the relevant month/week/day / number of products obligated to be supplied) exceeds the target value, or if the seller exceeds the daily product cancellation limits due to inability to supply, the account may be suspended after a 3-business-day period granted for the seller to take action and/or submit an objection, in order to prevent significant losses caused by high rates of supply failure and to maintain customer satisfaction.
If the same situation occurs for the second time, the seller's account will be suspended for 3 days, regardless of whether any action is taken. If the seller takes action, the account will be reopened at the end of the 3-day period. If no action is taken, the account will remain suspended until corrective action is taken.
If the same situation occurs for the third time, the seller's account will be suspended for 7 days, regardless of whether any action is taken. If the seller takes action, the account will be reopened at the end of the 7-day period. If no action is taken, the account will remain suspended until corrective action is taken.
If the same situation occurs for the fourth time, the seller's account will be suspended for 15 days, regardless of whether any action is taken. If the seller takes action, the account will be reopened at the end of the 15-day period. If no action is taken, the account will remain suspended until corrective action is taken.

If the seller takes action, the account will be reopened at the end of the 30-day period. If no action is taken, the account will remain suspended until corrective action is taken.

If the supply issue cannot be resolved through these improvements, the seller must provide information about their findings regarding the issue and the improvements made.
After the submitted information is reviewed by the relevant Trendyol teams, if it is determined that the seller has successfully resolved the supply issue, the account will be reopened for sales.

Low Micro Performance of Seller

High Unfulfillment Rate

If an increase exceeding the threshold value of 1% is detected in the seller's unfulfillment rate (compared to the total number of orders in the relevant month), the seller's store will be suspended in micro-export regions.
High Defective/Incorrect/Incomplete Product Return Rate
If an increase exceeding the threshold value of 1% is detected in the seller's defective/incorrect/incomplete product return rate (compared to the total number of orders in the relevant month), the seller's store will be suspended in micro-export regions.
High Customer Complaint Rate
If there is an increase exceeding the threshold value of 1% in negative reviews indicating that the seller's orders are incorrect, faulty, incomplete, or contain other performance-related issues, the seller's store will be suspended in micro-export regions.
High Return Rate
If the seller's total number of returns (excluding returns that could not be delivered to the customer) is found to exceed the threshold value of 10% (compared to total sales in the relevant month), the seller's store will be suspended in micro-export regions.
High Rate of Undelivered Shipments
If an increase exceeding the threshold value of 15% (compared to total sales in the relevant month) is
detected in the seller's undelivered shipments to customers, the seller's store will be suspended in micro-export regions.

International Shipping Delivery
If an increase exceeding 3 days is detected in the seller's international shipping delivery times, the seller's store will be suspended in micro-export regions.

Immediate Suspension of Micro Export Operations

If, within the relevant month, the seller's micro-export performance falls below the threshold values set for High Unable to Supply Rate, High Defective/Incorrect/Incomplete Product Return Rate, High Customer Complaint Rate, High Return Rate, or International Shipping Delivery, the seller's sales in micro-export regions will be immediately suspended. If the seller corrects the specified metrics in the following month, the seller may be reopened for micro-export according to the micro-export eligibility criteria calculated for the relevant period. If the seller cannot reach the threshold values specified for the relevant performance metrics, the seller's account will remain closed for micro-export.
Sellers can submit their objections regarding the calculated low performance metrics via Trendyol Assistant. If their objections are accepted, the seller will be reopened for micro-export in the following period.

Apart from the above situations that cause the seller to be closed on the grounds of violation of quality standards, the following actions may be taken in the presence of the following situations:

Reason for Account Closure

Details

Provision

Actions You Can Take

Official Authority Decision or Court Decision (including letters from Enforcement Directorates)

Account suspension may be implemented following a directive from an official authority or court order. This may occur if legal restrictions, such as an enforcement directive identifying the Seller as a debtor, affect the account.

The seller account will be suspended immediately.

Sellers may request reinstatement by providing:
- Documentation proving legal resolution of the suspension.
- An annulment letter from relevant enforcement authorities.

Continue a Partnership with a Different Current Account

It is applied in case of continuing the business partnership with a different current account.

The seller account will be suspended immediately.

You can activate your account. If you have pending sales, return and cancellation transactions in your car to be taken to passive status, you must complete these transactions.

Non-Acceptance of Amended Terms

If a Seller does not agree to amended terms, they have the right to terminate the Agreement without compensation within the specified 15-day period.

If a Seller terminates their agreement, their account will be suspended.

Sellers may review the amended terms, if the Seller does not agree with the amended terms, they have the right to terminate their agreement. The continued offering of products and services on the platform, shall, in any case, be considered a clear confirmation of the Amendment.

Failure to complete the application within the specified time

It is applied when no action has been taken on the application for a long time.

The application process is terminated immediately.

You can activate your application. In case you want to work with Trendyol again, you can contact us via Live Support in the seller center or via the Seller Support Line at 0850 258 58 00.

Statement of Financial Position

If the Seller becomes insolvent, bankrupt, enters liquidation, is subject to seizure proceedings, is in a state of loss of capital, or has a trustee appointed for management, Trendyol may temporarily suspend the account to prevent financial risks.

The seller account will be suspended immediately.

To reinstate the account, the Seller can provide evidence of financial solvency or resolve outstanding disputes. The Seller should contact Trendyol via Live Support, explaining any changes in their financial position (e.g., resolving credit debts, payment issues). If a court decision or official documentation is provided to show the removal of bankruptcy or financial risk, Trendyol will review and consider account reactivation.

Failure to Perform Invoice Cutting

Applied in cases where sellers fail to issue invoices after the sale.

The seller's account will be suspended immediately.

You can activate your account. You can report your statement that you can issue an invoice from Live Support on the seller panel or by contacting us via the Seller Support Line at 0850 258 58 00.

Failure to Update/Present Information

If the Seller fails to provide accurate, up-to-date, and complete information and documents as required, or fails to notify Trendyol of changes in such information, the Seller may be in breach of applicable legislation and platform requirements.

The seller account will be suspended immediately.

To reactivate the account, the Seller should update the necessary information or provide the missing documents.

Closing the Platform and/or the relevant category in which the Seller sells

In cases where the relevant category on the platform is closed, and this closure makes it  impossible for the Seller to continue sales in the specified category or product range.

The seller account will be closed immediately.

This action is taken as a result of platform or category closure, and reactivation is not applicable in this case. Sellers may consider alternative sales options or categories available on the platform if suitable. Otherwise, if the seller does not have any suitable product to continue selling, the seller account will be closed.

Increase in negative account balance

The seller's negative account balance (debt to Trendyol) reaches a high amount and this amount cannot be covered by the seller's past sales performance

The seller account is closed after 3 business days.

Within 3 business days, if you exercise your right of objection and your objection is sufficient and/or you bring your negative balance to a level to be covered by your past sales performance, the termination action will not take place.

Seller Failure to List Product

It is applied if a seller has not listed at least 1 product in the last 6 months and has not taken action at the end of 3 business days to take action in monthly checks.

The seller account will be closed at the end of 3 business days.

You can activate your account at any time in case of suspension. In case you want to work with Trendyol again, you can contact us via Live Support in the seller panel or via the Seller Support Hotline at 0850 258 58 00. You need to go through the verification process to activate your account.

The operational process of the product is evaluated based on the metrics specified in this section, and if low performance is observed in any of these metrics or across all of them, the visibility of your products may be restricted

High Defective/Wrong/Missing Product Return Rate
In the event that there is an increase in the ratio of returns due to defective/incorrect products to your total sales, the visibility of relevant products may be temporarily/permanently restricted in order to protect customer satisfaction.

Low Product Score
If there is an increase in negatively voted scores (1 and 2 are considered as low (negative) scores) your products may be temporarily/permanently restricted in order to protect customer satisfaction.

High Rate of Failure to Supply
If there is an increase in the ratio of the number of products that cannot be supplied to your total sales, the visibility of your products may be temporarily/permanently restricted in order to protect customer satisfaction.

Negative Product Reviews
If there is an increase in negative comments indicating that the product was sent incorrectly, was defective, or had other issues based on performance, the visibility of your products may be temporarily/permanently restricted in order to protect customer satisfaction.

If there is an increase in negatively voted scores (1 and 2 are considered as low (negative) scores) your products may be temporarily/permanently restricted in order to protect customer satisfaction.

High Rate of Failure to Supply
If there is an increase exceeding the 1% threshold in the ratio of the number of products that cannot be supplied to your total sales, the visibility of your products may be temporarily/permanently restricted in order to protect customer satisfaction.

High Rate of Complaints Regarding Received Products
If there is an increase in the rate of defective/incorrect/incomplete returns and in product supply, exchange requests and complaints reported through order enquiries regarding your delivered products that exceeds the 1% threshold, the sale of the relevant products may be suspended.

Complaints Regarding High Rates of Missing/Defective/Incorrect Product Shipments
If, there is an increase exceeding the 1% threshold in customer comments regarding incomplete/defective/incorrect products shipped within the last month, the sale of the relevant products may be suspended.

Immediate Product Closure

High Defective/Wrong/Missing Product Return Rate
You should support your packaging with the right material and perform visual and product quality control.

Color, size, and visual checks must be conducted for products; defective items should be separated from the inventory.

Products returned due to defects, faulty or missing should be analyzed, the issue should be identified, and appropriate actions should be taken.

Product reviews should be examined in detail, the issue on product should be identified, and taking necessary actions.

Necessary information (fabric details, accessory information if applicable, product content, etc.) should be complete and accurate on Product descriptions.

When preparing orders, it is ensured that the order contents are accurate, defective-free, and complete.

Products should be packaged in a way that prevents damage during transportation.

Low Product Score
You should examine the reviews of your products, identify those with low scores and take action.

High Rate of Failure to Supply
You should manage your stocks on other platforms separately and perform stock counting and quality control. You must complete the "Failure to Supply Rate Improvement Tips" training. During the period of suspension, the Seller must inform via "support" or the relevant operations officer that the inability to supply has been resolved by performing the following improvements as appropriate:
i) Entering product stocks into the system as 2 units less than the current stock (safety stock)
ii) Stocktaking for the product that cannot be supplied
iii) If the problem persists, stocktaking in all product groups
iv) If it is an integration-related problem, sharing the cause of the problem and the details of the improvement made to prevent it from happening again

High Customer Complaint Rate
You should check the customer complaints sent by e-mail, identify the specific problem in the product and take action to prevent the problem from recurring.
You should examine the reviews of your products, identify those with low scores and take action.

High Rate of Failure to Supply
You should manage your stocks on other platforms separately and perform stock counting and quality control. You must complete the "Failure to Supply Rate Improvement Tips" training.

High Rate of Complaints About Received Products
You should review return, complaint, supply, and exchange requests, identify problems during the product and packaging stages, and take the necessary actions.

Complaint Regarding High Rate of Missing/Defective/Incorrect Product Shipments
You should conduct quality control on your products that have been removed from sale for the relevant reasons, review product comments, identify problems with your products, and take the necessary actions.

Violation of Product Listing Rules/Content Quality

Products that are deemed to be in violation of product listing rules/content quality (including those containing health claims) will be closed for sale.

Immediate Product Closure

Content that violates product listing rules/content quality will not be resold. You need to upload the product again with correct and appropriate information.

Products that May React to Public Opinion

If a product's image, content, description and/or other elements are significantly inconsistent with general market standards or consumer expectations and/or are likely to cause misleading, opportunistic and/or disturbing public opinion, these products will be closed for sale.

Immediate Product Closure

Products that may cause a public outcry are not put back on sale.

ANNEX 1.9: RULES FOR SHIPPING ABROAD WITH MICRO EXPORT

Rules for Shipping Abroad with Micro Export

Necessity

Rules

Consequences of not Following the Rules

Mandatory Customs Registration

In order for companies that will sell abroad for the first time, in order to make customs declarations, they must be registered as exporters in the customs system before the transactions.
1. Private companies can register via e-government.
2. Registration of other types of companies is carried out by customs officers affiliated with the Ministry of Commerce.
3. The transaction in Article 2 can also be carried out through authorized ETGB operators and contracted customs consultancy companies.

It is not systematically possible to carry out export declaration procedures for companies that are not customs registered. For this reason, it is possible for shipments of unregistered companies to be stopped at customs.
In such a case, the transportation status of other shipments in the same customs declaration will also be negatively affected. If this negativity causes administrative and financial losses, the seller who sends the shipment even though it is not registered at customs may be held responsible.

Micro Export Authorization Certificate (Indirect Representation Authorization Statement)

Sellers who want to open up to micro export must approve the Indirect Representation Authorization Statement sent to them through their seller center.

Sellers who do not approve the Indirect Representation Authorization Declaration will not be opened to Micro Export.

Product Selection

If sellers open themselves to micro exports by approving the Indirect Representation Authorization Declaration, they will be able to sell only the products that they have selected through the seller center. TRENDYOL  may, at any time, put all of the seller's products on sale by giving prior notice to certain countries within the scope of micro export. In such a case, the seller may remove some products from the list of the products that he does not want to sell in these countries within the period given in the notification.
Sellers may not see all the products they offer for sale in Turkey in the micro export eligible product list. The reason for this is that only products that have been pre-qualified for micro export have been transferred to the product list by TRENDYOL. Pre-eligibility is granted by taking into account the general micro export rules (in accordance with the micro export regulations= the invoice amount must be less than 15,000 Euros and the weight of the goods sold must be less than 300 kilograms).
Therefore, the eligibility of the product in terms of other conditions (product safety, permits, originality, content, etc.) should be determined by the seller and the product selection should be made accordingly.

A product approved for sale by the seller must be suitable for micro export. If the product is stuck at customs due to non-compliance and/or slows down or prevents the customs exit of other products grouped with it, the seller may be held liable for administrative and financial damages that may be caused by the relevant operational problems.

Invoice Preparation

1. The seller who will send products via micro export must have the ability to issue E-Archive invoices.
2. The invoice can be prepared in Turkish. However, it is recommended to prepare it in English.
3. The e-archive invoice to be issued must be in the "exception" type and with 0% VAT with the 301 goods export code.
4. The invoice must include all of the following information:
*Sender company name, address, tax office and tax number
*Recipient's information (title, address information including country name, tax number if available)
*Editing date and time
* Invoice type
*Invoice number
*Invoice date
*Delivery condition
*Origin of the product (In case there are products of different origin in the same invoice, origin information must be provided on a product basis.)
*Number of the product sent
*Detailed description of the product sent
*Delivery method of the product sent
*Reason for tax exemption (Export invoice must be prepared excluding VAT. You can proceed by selecting the exception code "301- Goods Export".)
See for Sample Invoice.

1. For micro export shipments, an invoice should not be included in the cargo.
2. Since e-invoice will only be valid for exports made with Customs Exit Declaration, micro exports cannot be made with e-invoices.
3. If there is missing/incorrect information on the invoice, the declaration cannot be made or is made incorrectly (such as sample output instead of export).
4. In case of incorrect SCD declaration, the company (carrier/customs company) and the seller making the declaration may face the risk of receiving irregularity penalties.
5. In case of incomplete or incorrect declaration, additional checks may be required and the customs process may be prolonged.
6. In addition, if exporting companies that issue incorrect invoices are audited, they may receive irregularity fines or our sellers may encounter problems when they want to receive a VAT refund.

Simplified Customs Declaration (SCD)

Formerly known as ETGB

1. Declarations regarding micro export must be made only by companies that are SCD operators.
2. The weight of products subject to micro export should not exceed 300 kg, and their value should not exceed 15K Euro.
3. Within the scope of SCD, only exports for definitive and commercial sales purposes are allowed.
4. Exports exceeding the limit, temporary exits for fair and exhibition purposes, and products that are restricted, subject to permission, or subject to inspection cannot be sent within the scope of micro export.
5. In order for the SCD declaration to be made correctly, product invoices and all necessary documents must be submitted to the operator companies accurately and completely.

1. The shipment of export restricted or permit-requiring products that cannot be micro-exported may disrupt the operation.
2. Customs Exit Declaration (CED) must be completed for the export transactions of products that are not subject to any obstacles to export but are not within the scope of SCD.
If a Seller sends
· Incorrect GTIP (HS Code) code,
. Incorrect origin information or
· Any false statement about the product and/or
· Incorrect/prohibited products
The Seller will be responsible for the penalties that the Seller will face.
Additionally, if the information in question is entered incorrectly, the seller will not be able to write off income as exports and will not be able to receive a VAT refund, since the customs declaration cannot be prepared. Therefore, it is important to enter the information correctly.

GTIP code

In order for the seller to complete both the export of the products and the import procedures in the destination country without any errors, the classification of the product (items) offered for sale must be made correctly. Likewise, it is important to declare GTIP (HS Code) codes correctly so that customs duties can be collected correctly.
As TRENDYOL, we provide our sellers with a recommended GTIP (HS Code) information on the screen on which we show their products suitable for import. If this suggestion is not correct, our sellers need to edit the code information by entering the correct code of their product. TRENDYOL  is not responsible for the recommendation code information and this recommendation is only to facilitate the seller's transactions. It is the seller's responsibility to check the accuracy of the code and correct it if not.

Seller will be responsible for all the negative consequences of incorrect GTIP code entry such as, not being able to prepare a customs declaration due to this situation and therefore not being able to receive a VAT refund, the product being stuck at customs, irregularity penalties and penalties being imposed at the destination country customs in case of detection of incomplete or non-paid customs duty due to incorrect GTIP.

Product Front Page Information

The following information, which must be included in the export invoice of the product, must be included on the product page. The seller is responsible for filling in the relevant information.
· Product origin (COO) information
·Detailed description of the product

If a Seller send·
. Incorrect origin information or
· Any false statement about the product and/or
· Incorrect/prohibited products
·Failure to receive VAT and underpayment of customs duty
He/she will be responsible for the penalties he/she will face.

Cargo Package

1. Absolutely no gifts, giveaways, notes, etc. should be included in the export shipment packages. Items and advertising elements should not be placed.
2. TRENDYOL  instructions regarding the documents that should/should not be included in the package must be followed. Invoices should not be included in micro export shipments.
3. If there are products for Micro Export and other shipments in an order, automatic package division is applied so that the Micro Export shipments are in separate packages. The current shipping cost for each divided package is reflected to the Seller.

If there is a problem in the operation of the shipment due to the documents or gift products placed in the shipment packages for export, the seller will be responsible for the costs, penalties and any damages that may occur.

MSDS Form

In accordance with aircraft cargo transportation, it is necessary to document with MSDS forms whether liquids and a group of solid goods contain dangerous substances and whether they are generally suitable for transportation, and these forms must be submitted to cargo companies along with the product.
Since MSDS forms are prepared by manufacturers, sellers who sell products that require MSDS forms must obtain these forms from the manufacturer.

If the MSDS form which is requested during the transportation process cannot be submitted, the transportation of products cannot be realized and the seller will be responsible for all costs, penalties and damages of any kind.

Product Price Display

For the products to be presented for sale, the Turkey sales price determined by the seller through the seller panel will be taken as basis.
A portion of TRENDYOL 's operational costs will be added to the Turkey sales price set by the seller for the product. The prices calculated in this way will be converted into the currency of the relevant country and displayed to customers in the relevant currency.
Sellers may change the final selling price in the export country by changing the selling price in Turkey.
Commissions and progress payments for such sales will be determined based on the sales price in Turkey.

In the first stage, since the product prices of our sellers will be translated by TRENDYOL  according to the principles specified based on the prices in Turkey, sellers do not need to take any action to comply with the price display.

When the infrastructure to set country-based prices for our sellers is activated, the rules to be followed regarding price display rules will be determined according to the relevant laws.

Operational Rules

1. In order to have TRENDYOL  cargo code for an order to be generated in the system, the seller must create an invoice suitable for micro export for this order and upload it to the relevant screen or make sure that the invoice is automatically fed by the system. The cargo code for an order whose invoice does not exist in our systems will not be generated and therefore the order will not be in "in transit" status. For orders that do not enter the "in transit" status, existing platform practices (delay, failure to supply, seller rating, etc.) will apply.
2. The customer order must be supplied completely and accurately. Before the products are put up for sale, the seller must check the stock, price and suitability for shipping to the customer, both physically and systematically. Incorrect stock and price entries should not be made.
3. The products in the order must be supplied flawlessly, accurately and completely. Defective, wrong or incomplete products should not be sent and customer dissatisfaction should not be created.
4. Orders must be delivered to the cargo within the deadline and the “shipped/in transit” status must be reported to the TRENDYOL  system within the deadline.
5. The release of orders should be planned in accordance with daily cargo capacities and should be done without exceeding the deadline. Orders that are not shipped within the deadline are considered delayed.
6. There must be TRENDYOL  cargo codes on the order packages, and exits should not be made with cargo codes that TRENDYOL  cannot detect.
7. Sellers must generate new shipping codes by using the "split package" feature in the seller center for orders that they cannot package in a single parcel. Otherwise, if more than one package is issued with a single shipping code, packages without a shipping code may be lost and cannot be sent to the customer.
8. In the event that it is understood that the product subject to the order is not suitable for export due to the legislation of the country where the micro export of the product will be made, operational restrictions in the export process, legal regulations at customs and similar reasons and therefore it is determined that it cannot be exported, the actions that will be carried out are;
●  Return of orders that are in transit to the seller
● Orders that are not in transit will be canceled directly.
9. The Seller agrees that the product shipment packages sold within the scope of micro exports may be sent subject to consolidation to be determined by TRENDYOL , that TRENDYOL  is authorized to take the necessary measures regarding the suitability of the shipments for consolidation, and that the consolidation application may differ in terms of countries within the scope of micro exports and categories / products within the same country.
10. The Seller undertakes that if the Seller fails to deliver any product sold within the scope of micro-export within 15 (fifteen) days after the end of the Handling time and/or fails to notify TRENDYOL  of the "in transit" status of the Product, the order for the relevant product will be canceled and any and all liability in this context shall be borne by the Seller.

Micro export operations of sellers on the platform who do not comply with the operational rules in this section, including the basic rules for operation such as arranging invoices, MSDS and shipping packages, may be stopped.

Compliance with the Legislation of the Micro Export Country

The Seller accepts, declares and undertakes that it will act in accordance with the legislation regulations, customs, intellectual and industrial property, consumer, electronic commerce, especially product safety, customs, customs, intellectual and industrial property, consumer, electronic commerce, and administrative decisions and regulations of authorized public institutions and organizations of the countries where micro exports are made.

The Seller shall be responsible for the costs, penalties and any damages in case of breach.

Prohibited Products

The Seller shall not offer for sale in the relevant micro-export country the products/categories that are included in the list to be notified by TRENDYOL  and/or prohibited for sale in the electronic commerce environment in accordance with the legislative regulations, customs and administrative decisions and regulations of the competent public institutions and organizations of the micro-export countries; shall not list any product prohibited for sale from the wrong product/category and / or with the wrong product information in violation of this obligation.

## [Temel Kavramlar] Mikro İhracat'ta Reklam Yönetimi
<!-- slug: mikro-ihracatta-reklam-yonetimi -->

Mikro İhracat’ta Ürün Reklamları
Trendyol’da Mikro İhracat yaptığınız ülkelerde ürünlerinizi ön plana çıkarmak için bütçe belirleyerek istediğiniz ürünleri seçebilir ve ürün reklamları oluşturabilirsiniz.
Ürün reklamları ile ürünlerinizi Trendyol arama sonuçları, ürün listeleri, sana özel ürünler gibi farklı alanlarda öne çıkarma fırsatı bulabilirsiniz.
Ürün reklamlarında performans odaklı çalışan Otomatik Teklif uygulamasını deneyebilirsiniz. Bu sayede akıllı algoritmaları, sizin için en iyi yatırım dönüşü sağlayacak şekilde ayarlayabilirsiniz.
Mikro İhracat’ta Ürün Reklamları Nasıl Oluşturabilirim?

Satıcı Paneli’nde Reklam Yönetimi > Ürün Reklamları ekranına giriş yapabilirsiniz.
Yeni Reklam Oluştur butonu ile ürün reklamı oluşturma ekranına giriş yapabilirsiniz.
Reklamın Yayınlanacağı Ülke alanında Mikro İhracat yaptığınız ülkelerden seçim yapabilirsiniz.
Reklam tarihleri ve bütçe belirledikten sonra reklam verilecek ürünlerinizin seçimini yapabilir ve ürün reklamı oluşturabilirsiniz.

Mikro İhracat’ta Ürün Reklamı İpuçları

Doğru Ürünleri Seçin: BuyBox kazanan, yüksek stoklu, iyi yorumlu, açıklamaları eksiksiz ürünleri tercih edin.
Benzer Ürünlere Birlikte Reklam Verin: Aynı kategoriden, benzer ürünler seçmek, tıklama başına maliyetin (TBM) daha verimli şekilde dağıtılmasına yardımcı olur.
Tek Reklamda En Az 5 Ürün Ekleyin: Reklam performansınızı artırmaya yardımcı olacaktır.
Tıklama Başına Maliyet (TBM) için Otomatik Teklif Verme Özelliğini Kullanın: Sistemin her bir ürün için en iyi TBM’yi zahmetsizce belirlemesini sağlamak için otomatik teklif verme özelliğini kullanabilirsiniz.
Reklamları En Az 7 Gün Boyunca Yayınlayın: Reklamları çok erken durdurmaktan kaçının ve en az 7 gün boyunca yayınlayın.
Teklifleri ve Ürünleri Düzenli Olarak Ayarlayın: Düşük performans gösteren ürünleri duraklatabilir, teklifleri güncelleyebilir veya bütçenizi optimize etmek için yeni ürünler ekleyebilirsiniz.
Daha İyi Sıralama için Tıklama Başına Maliyet’i (TBM) Artırın: Ürününüz zaten organik olarak potansiyel reklam konumundan daha üst sıralarda yer alıyorsa, reklam bütçeniz harcanmayacaktır.
Performansınızı Takip Edin: Gösterim, tıklama, TBM ve dönüşüm oranlarını analiz ederek gerekli aksiyonları planlayabilirsiniz.

Mikro İhracat’ta Influencer Reklamları
Komisyonlu influencer reklamı, Trendyol'daki ürünlerinizin ve markanızın influencer'lar tarafından Instagram'da hikaye formatında paylaşılmasıdır.
Komisyonlu influencer reklamı, ürünleriniz satıldıkça belirleyeceğiniz komisyon oranında ödeme yapacağınız reklam modelidir. Yani, yalnızca satış olduğunda ödeme yapılır.
Mikro İhracat’ta Influencer Reklamları Nasıl Oluşturabilirim?

Satıcı Paneli'nde Reklam Yönetimi > Influencer Reklamları ekranına giriş yapabilirsiniz.
Yeni Reklam Oluştur butonu ile influencer reklamı oluşturma ekranına giriş yapabilirsiniz.
Reklam Bilgileri sayfasında reklamınızın yayınlanacağı Mikro İhracat ülkesini, satın alınan her ürün için ödeyeceğiniz komisyon oranını ve tarih aralığını seçmeniz gereklidir.
Bilgi Formu sayfasında reklamınızla ilgili influencer'ların paylaşımında belirtilmesini istediğiniz bilgileri, kampanyaları ve mention'lanacak hesap bilgilerinin girişini yapabilirsiniz.
Teklifinizi onaylamadan önce Influencer Reklam Çalışması Sözleşmesi’ni inceleyerek onaylamanız gereklidir.

## [Temel Kavramlar] İhracat Merkezi Sık Sorulan Sorular
<!-- slug: ihracat-merkezi-sik-sorulan-sorular -->

Panel Açılış Soruları

1. İhracat Merkezi başvuru ekranları hangi satıcılar için açıktır?
İhracat Merkezi Paneli satış ve operasyon durumu uygun olan satıcılar için açılmıştır. Ekran açılışlarında Trendyol Pazaryeri’nde listelediğiniz ürünleri, satış haciminiz, operasynel durumunuz gibi parametreler göz önnüde bulundurulmaktadır.

2. İhracat merkezi başvuru ekranlarını göremiyorum, talep oluşturabilir miym?
Maalesef hayır. Uygunluğunuz olduğu durumda başvuru ekranları açılacaktır. Bu esnada eğer mikro ihracat için uygunluğunuz var ise Türkiye Satıcı Paneli’nizden mikro ihracat yapabilirsiniz.

3. İhracat Merkezi başvuru ekranlarındaki soruların nedeni nedir?
Başvuru formunda yer alan sorular bilgi amaçlı yurtdışı satış uygunluğunuzu belirleyebilmek adına sorulmaktadır.

4. İhracat Merkezi'ne yüklenen ürünler nerelerde satılıyor?
Trendyol’un kendi yurtdışı platformları olan Almanya, Belçika, Hollanda, Avusturya, Bulgaristan, Çek Cumhuriyeti, Yunanistan, Macaristan, Polonya, Romanya ve Slovakya’da ürünleriniz listelenebilir ve ürünlerinizi Avrupa’ya ulaştırabilirsiniz. Aynı zamanda GULF bölgesinde Suudi Arabistan, Birleşik Arap Emirliği, Bahreyn, Kuveyt, Omman ve Katar’da ürünleriniz listelenebilir ve dünyanın farklı yerlerine ürünlerinizi ulaştırabilirsiniz.

5. İhracat Merkezi’nde satıcılardan beklenen nedir?
Yurtdışında satışa uygun ürünlerinize ait bilgi girişini yapmanız ve yeni oluşacak siparişlerinizi uygun standartlarda paketleyerek göndermenizi bekliyoruz.

6. İhracat işlemi nasıl yapılıyor, satıcıların tamamlaması gereken bilgi, belge veya kayıt var mıdır?
Satıcılardan herhangi bir bilgi, belge veya kayıt işlemi beklenmemektedir. İhracat Merkezi üzerinden satışı gerçekleşen ürünlerinizin satın alma işlemini Türkiye sınırları içerisinde TRENDYOL yapmaktadır. Trendyol ürünlerinizin satın almasını yaparak ihracat işlemini sizin yerinize kendi yürütmektedir.

7. Türkiye Satıcı Panelim pasif veya tatil modunda, ihracat merkezi operasyonu yürütebilir miyim?
Evet, yürütebilirsiniz.

8. Teknik API dokümanı var mı?
Evet, buradan API’a ulaşabilirsiniz. API’yı sadece başvuru süreci tamamlanmış olan satıcılar kullanabilir.

Ürün Yükleme ve Fiyatlandırma Soruları

9. Hangi ürünleri İhracat Merkezi’nde satabilirim?
Türkiye Satıcı Paneli'nde onaylı olan ve Trendyol tarafından ihracatı uygun olan ürünlerinizin satışını yapabilirsiniz. Ürünlerinizin Türkiye Satıcı Paneli’nde stoğu olmasa bile İhracat Merkezi’nde satmaya başlayabilirsiniz.
Aynı zamanda arşivlenmiş ürünlerinizi İhracat Merkezi’nde satabilirsiniz.

10. Tüm ürünlerimi ihracat merkezinde açamıyorum, neden?
Satışı uygun ürün olan ürünleriniz "İhracata Uygun Ürünler" sayfasında gösterilmektedir, burada olan ürünleriniz dışında ürün açılışı yapamazsınız.

11. Ürünlerim zaten satıcı panelinde var, neden tekrar giriş yapıyorum?
Türkiye Satıcı Paneli’ndeki bilgilere ek olarak ürün üzerinde bazı bilgilerin eklenmesi gerekmektedir. Bu zorunluluk yurtdışında ürün listelenebilmesi ve gümrük geçişleri için gereklidir, Trendyol tarafından belirlenmemiştir.
Ek Giriş İstenen Alanlar:
   - Materyal Bileşeni ve Oranı: %90 Pamuk, %10 Keten gibi
   - Menşei Bilgisi (ürün üretim yeri)
   - GTİP

12. Ürünlerim nerelerde listeleniyor?
Ürünleriniz Trendyol'un belirlediği platformlarda listelenmekdir. Sipariş oluştuktan sonra satış gören ülke bilgisini görebilirsiniz.

13. Tüm ürünlerimi yurtdışı platformlarında göremiyorum. Neden?
- Ürününüz ilgili ülkede satışa uygun olmayabilir.
- Trendyol tarafından belirlenen kuralsetlerine uygun olmayabilir.
- Stok dağılımı nedeniyle farklı bir platformda listeleniyor olabilir.

14. Ürün fiyat girişini nasıl yapabilirim?
“İhracata Uygun Ürünler” sayfasından fiyat girişi yaparak ve eksik ürün bilgilerini tamamlayarak ürünlerinizi ihracata açabilirsiniz.
Yayında olan ürünlerinizin fiyatlarını "İhracata Açık Ürünler" sayfasından güncelleyebilirsiniz.

15. Ürün fiyatlarımı nasıl belirlemeliyim?
Trendyol Global - Otomatik Listeleme & Satış (Trendyol İhracat Merkezi) modeli kapsamında "İhracat Merkezi" üzerinden listelediğiniz ürünler nihai müşterilere yapılan satışlara istinaden Trendyol tarafından siz iş ortaklarımızdan satın alınmaktadır. Dolayısıyla belirleyeceğiniz ürün satış fiyatları, ürünlerin Trendyol'a satış fiyatlarıdır.
Ürün satış fiyatlarının belirlemesinde aşağıdaki hususları göz önünde bulundurmanızı tavsiye ederiz:

Uygunluk çerçevesinde ürünlerinizi taşıma operasyonu Trendyol tarafından yapılmakta; ürünler deponuzdan teslim alınmaktadır.
Ürünlerinizi toplu ve günlük olarak paketlediğiniz beklendiği için işçilik maliyetinizin düşük olacağı tahmin edilmektedir.
Ürünün nihai müşterisi ürünü teslim aldıktan sonra iade ettiğinde şu an için sizlere iade yansıtılmamaktadır. Bu nedenle bu kapsamda iade operasyonu ve maliyetiniz bulunmamaktadır.
Satışlarınız üzerinden komisyon faturası kesilmemektedir.

16. Trendyol belirlediğim fiyatları kabul etmeme hakkına sahip mi?
Evet, İhracat Merkezi üzerinden listediğiniz ürünler nihai müşterilere yapılan satışlara istinaden Trendyol tarafından siz iş ortaklarımızdan satın alınmaktadır. Eğer belirlediğiniz ürün satış fiyatları Trendyol’un satın almak istediği fiyatın üzerindeyse Trendyol'un o ürünü listelememe ve satın almama hakkı saklıdır.

17. Ürün stok belirlemesini nasıl yapabilirim?
“İhracata Uygun Ürünler” sayfasından stok girişi yaparak ve eksik ürün bilgilerini tamamlayarak ürünlerinizi ihracata açabilirsiniz.
Yayında olan ürünlerinizin stoklarını "İhracata Açık Ürünler" sayfasından güncelleyebilirsiniz.
Dilersiniz İhracat Merkezi’ndeki stoklarınızı Türkiye Satıcı Paneli ile ortak yönetebilirsiniz. Bu tercih hakkı başvuru aşamasında satıcılara sorulmaktadır, seçiminize göre stok yönetiminiz yapılmaktadır.
Eğer tercihinizi daha sonradan değiştirmek isterseniz satıcı destek hattı üzerinden bize ulaşabilirsiniz.

Sipariş & Paket Soruları

18. Paket nedir?
İhracat Merkezi’nde satılan ürünlerinizi tek tek göndermenizi beklemiyoruz. Bu nedenle günde 1 defa saat 08:00’de toplu bir paket oluşturuyoruz ve bu paket içerisinde göndermenizi beklediğiniz ürünleri gösteriyoruz.
Bir paket içerisinde farklı ülkelere ve/veya farklı platformlara satılan ürünleriniz olabilir.
Paket içerisindeki ürünleri uygun paketleme yöntemiyle paketleyip kolileyerek göndermenizi bekliyoruz.

19. Paket oluştuktan sonra kime ve nasıl fatura keseceğim?
İhracat Merkezi’ndeki satışlara ait ürünlerinizi satın alan Trendyol’dur. Bu nedenle ürün faturanızı TRENDYOL’a kesmeniz gerekmektedir.
Satış işlemi Türkiye içerisinde olduğu için KDV dahil olarak fatura kesilmelidir.
İhracat Merkezi’nde gösterilen fiyatlar KDV dahil fiyatlardır.
Detaylar için eğitim dokümanını inceleyebilirsiniz.

20. Ürünlerimi nasıl paketlemeliyim?
Ürün paketleme kuralları için eğitime buradan ulaşabilirsiniz.

21. Ürünlerimi nasıl gönderebilirim?
Ürün gönderim kuralları için eğitime buradan ulaşabilirsiniz.

Finansal Sorular

22. Komisyon uygulaması var mı?
Siparişleriniz üzerinden komisyon uygulanmamaktadır.

23. Hizmet Bedeli uygulaması var mı?
Evet, hizmet bedeli uygulanmaktadır.

24. Kargo ücreti var mı?
Eğer depo adresiniz İstanbul'da ise ve Trendyol ekipleri tarafından alım için uygunsa herhangi bir kargo bedeliniz bulunmamaktadır. Operasyonel işlemler için tarafınıza hizmet bedeli olarak tarafınıza yansıtılmaktadır.
Depo adresiniz istanbul dışında ise veya Trendyol ekipleri tarafından alıma uygun değilse kargo gönderimini kendiniz anlaşmalı olduğunuz kargo firması ile göndermenizi bekliyoruz. Trendyol olarak aradaki kargo sürecine şu an için dahil olmuyoruz.

## [Temel Kavramlar] İhracat Merkezi Paketlerinin Depoya Gönderim Yöntemleri Hakkında Bilgilendirme
<!-- slug: ihracat-merkezi-paketlerinin-depoya-gonderim-yontemleri-hakkinda-bilgilendirme -->

İhracat Merkezi üzerinden satışını gerçekleştirdiğiniz paketleri Trendyol Depo’ya en kısa sürede ulaştırmanızı bekliyoruz. Paketlerinizi depoya ulaştırmak için kullandığınız yöntemleri, artık İhracat Merkezi üzerinden gerçekleştirebileceksiniz. Tüm taleplerinizi tek bir yerden yönetmenizi sağlayarak size daha iyi bir deneyim sunmayı amaçlıyoruz.
Bu sayede hangi paketlerinizi depoya göndermek için randevu oluşturduğunuzu/kargoladığınızı daha kolay takip edip eksik kalan paketleriniz için daha hızlı gönderim sağlayabilirsiniz.
Araç talep etme: Mevcutta bu yöntemle gönderim yapıyorsanız; FYS sistemi yerine İhracat Merkezi üzerinden tek tıkla araç talep edebileceksiniz:

“Tedarik Beklenenler” sekmesinden ilgili paket için “Gönderim Yöntemi” alanından “Araç Talep Et” butonuna tıklayın.

Açılan pop-up üzerinden aracın gelmesini istediğiniz tarih, saat gibi bilgileri doldurarak araç talep edebilirsiniz.

Bu talebi ilgili paket üzerinde görüntüleyebilir; isterseniz talebi revize edebilir ya da iptal edebilirsiniz.

Not: Lojistik araçları ile teslimat yalnızca İstanbul içi belirli bölgelerden yapılabilmektedir.
Depoya direkt teslim etme: Paketleri kendi aracınızla teslim edecekseniz, bu talebi İhracat Merkezi üzerinden ileterek depodaki ilgili rampa için rezervasyon oluşturabilirsiniz.

“Tedarik Beklenenler” sekmesinden ilgili paket için “Gönderim Yöntemi” alanından “Diğer Yöntemler” butonuna tıklayın. “Depoya direkt teslim et” seçeneğini kullanın.

Açılan pop-up üzerinden ilgili bilgileri doldurarak talebinizi oluşturun.

Talep oluşturduğunuzda paket üzerinde depo & rampa bilgilerini görüntüleyebilirsiniz.

Kargo ile gönderme: Paketleri kargo firmasına teslim ederek gönderdiyseniz, kargo takip numarasını İhracat Merkezi üzerinden tarafımıza bildirmelisiniz.

“Tedarik Beklenenler” sekmesinden ilgili paket için “Gönderim Yöntemi” alanından “Diğer Yöntemler” butonuna tıklayın. “Kargo kodu bildir” seçeneğini kullanın.

Açılan pop-up üzerinden kargo firması ve kargo kodu bilgilerini doldurun.

Talep oluşturduğunuzda paket üzerinde kargo firması ve kargo takip numarası bilgilerini görüntüleyebilirsiniz.

## [Reklam] Reklam Sözlüğü
<!-- slug: reklam-sozlugu -->

Genel Terimler

Ürün Reklamı: Ürünlerinizin arama sonuçlarında reklam alanlarında daha üst sıralarda yer almasını sağlayarak ziyaretlerinizi ve satışlarınızı artırma fırsatı veren bir reklam ürünüdür. Detaylı kampanya raporlarıyla reklam performansınızı takip edebilir ve aksiyon alabilirsiniz.

Mağaza Reklamı: Satıcı mağazanızın ve seçtiğiniz ürünlerinizin Trendyol arama sayfalarında en üst sırada yer alan reklam alanında gözükmesini sağlayan reklam çözümüdür.

Sponsorlu Ürün / Sponsorlu: Reklam süresince reklam verilen ürün ya da mağazada gözüken etikettir.

Influencer Reklamı: Trendyol’daki ürünlerinizin ve markanızın Influencer’lar tarafından Instagram story/hikaye olarak paylaşılmasıdır. Ürünleriniz satıldıkça belirlediğiniz komisyon oranı üzerinden ödeme yaparsınız.

FB/IG Reklamı: Facebook ve Instagram Reklamları,  Trendyol’daki ürünlerinize ve ürünlerinizin dahil olduğu kategorilere ilgi göstermiş kullanıcıları yeniden hedeflemenizi sağlayan bir reklam çözümüdür.

Buybox: Trendyol'da aynı ürünü birden fazla satıcı sattığı durumda belirlenen algoritma metrikleriyle müşterilere maksimum fayda sağlayacak satıcıyı seçen ve bu satıcının ürününü yukarı taşıyan sisteme buybox denir. Ürünü satan diğer satıcılar ise Buybox puanlarına göre ürün sayfasının altında "Ürünün Diğer Satıcıları" kısmında sıralanırlar.

İşleme Alındı: Reklam oluşturma talebiniz alınmıştır ve seçtiğiniz tarihte yayına girer.

Yayında: Oluşturduğunuz reklamın başlangıç tarihi geldiğinde yayına alınır.

Duraklatıldı: Yayındaki reklamı duraklattığınızda reklam bu statüye geçer. Tekrar yayına almak için ilgili reklamda işlem başlığı altındaki «Devam Et» butonuna tıklamalısınız.

Sonlandırılıyor: Oluşturduğunuz reklamı sonlandırma talebi verdiğinizde ilgili reklam sonrandırılma sırasına alınır.

Sonlandırıldı: Oluşturduğunuz reklamı sonlandırabilirsiniz ve reklam yayından kalkar.

Tamamlandı: Oluşturduğunuz reklam başarıyla tamamlanmıştır.

Yetersiz Bakiye: Bakiye yetersizliği sebebiyle reklam duraklatılmıştır. Bakiye yükledikten sonra reklamınızı devam ettirebilirsiniz.

Ürün ve Mağaza Reklam Terimleri

Toplam Reklam Bakiyesi: Ürün ve mağaza reklamlarında harcanabilir olan toplam bakiyeyi gösterir, bu bakiyeye hediye bakiye tutarları dahildir.

Reklam Bütçesi:  İlgili reklam için ayrılan bütçeyi göstermektedir.

Harcanan Bütçe: İlgili reklam için harcanan bütçeyi göstermektedir.

Gerçekleşen TBM: Reklam için harcanan bütçenin tıklanma sayısına bölünmesi ile hesaplanır.

Önerilen TBM: Seçilen ürünlere göre sistem tarafından hesaplanarak önerilen tıklanma başına maliyet teklif önerisidir.

Teklif Edilen TBM: Belirlemiş olduğunuz tıklanma başına maliyet teklifinizi belirtir.

Gösterim Sayısı: Reklamınızın Trendyol platformları üzerinde toplam gösterilme sayısıdır.

Tıklanma Sayısı: Reklamınızın müşteriler tarafından tıklanma sayısıdır.

Reklam Cirosu: Reklam ürününü görüntüleyen müşterilerin, 7 gün içerisinde ilgili satıcıdan ürün satın almasıyla elde edilen toplam reklam cirosudur.

Reklam Getirisi: Reklamlardan elde edilen toplam cironun, reklam harcamalarınıza bölümüdür.

Tıklanma Oranı: Tıklanma sayısının gösterim sayısına bölünmesiyle elde edilen orandır.

Ürün Reklamı Satış Adedi: Reklam ürününü görüntüleyen müşterilerin, 7 gün içerisinde reklamlı üründen elde ettiği doğrudan ve dolaylı satış adetlerinin toplamıdır.

Doğrudan Satış Adedi: Reklam ürününü görüntüleyen müşterilerin, 7 gün içerisinde reklamlı ürünü satın almasıyla elde edilen doğrudan satış adedidir.

Dolaylı Satış Adedi: Reklam ürününü görüntüleyen müşterilerin, 7 gün içerisinde reklamlı ürün sayesinde satıcının diğer ürünlerini satın almasıyla elde edilen dolaylı satış adedidir.

Mağaza Reklamı Satış Adedi: Mağaza reklamını görüntüleyen müşterilerin, 14 gün içerisinde mağaza reklamındaki reklamlı üründen elde ettiği doğrudan ve dolaylı satış adetlerinin toplamıdır

Doğrudan Satış Adedi: Mağaza reklamını görüntüleyen müşterilerin, 14 gün içerisinde mağaza reklamı alanında görülen 4 üründen birini satın almasıyla elde edilen doğrudan satış adedidir.

Dolaylı Satış Adedi: Mağaza reklamını görüntüleyen müşterilerin, 14 gün içerisinde mağaza reklamı alanında görünmeyen, mağazanın detayına girip başka bir ürünü satın almasıyla elde edilen dolaylı satış adedidir.

Gerçekleşen GBM: Reklam için harcanan bütçenin gösterim sayısına bölünmesi ile hesaplanır.

Önerilen GBM: Seçilen arama kelimeleri ve algoritma metrikleri ile sistem tarafından hesaplanarak önerilen gösterim başına maliyet teklif önerisidir.

Teklif Edilen GBM: Belirlemiş olduğunuz gösterim başına maliyet teklifinizi belirtir.

Influencer Reklamı Terimleri

Ödenecek Tutar: Bu miktar influencer'a ödenecek miktardır. Reklam süresince ve reklam sonlandıktan sonraki 7 gün içerisinde satılan ürünlerden verilen komisyon oranına göre hesaplanır.

Mağaza Ziyareti: Influencer reklamında Influencer paylaşımları sonucu gelen mağaza sayfasınıza gelen ziyaret sayısıdır.

Reklam Cirosu: Influencer reklamı sonucunda yaptığınız toplam satış miktarıdır.

Paylaşım Sayısı: Influencer reklamının kaç defa paylaşıldığını gösterir.

İptal & İade Tutarı: Influencer reklamınızdan satın alınan ürünlerin ne kadarının iptal ve iade edildiğini gösterir.

Reklam Ziyareti: Influencer'ın paylaşımı sonucunda gelen ziyaret sayısıdır.

Ciro: Influencer'ın paylaşımı sonucunda gelen satış miktarıdır.

Satış Adedi: Influencer'ın paylaşımı sonucunda gelen satış sayısıdır.

Doğrudan Satış Adedi: Reklam verilen ürünleri görüntüleyen müşterilerin, 7 gün içerisinde reklamlı ürünleri satın almasıyla elde edilen doğrudan satış adedidir.

Dolaylı Satış Adedi: Reklam verilen ürünleri  görüntüleyen müşterilerin, 7 gün içerisinde reklamlı ürünler sayesinde satıcının diğer ürünlerini satın almasıyla elde edilen dolaylı satış adedidir.

Doğrudan Komisyon Oranı: Satıcının reklam verdiği ürünlerin satılması durumunda ödenecek komisyon miktarıdır.

Dolaylı Komisyon Oranı: Satıcının reklam vermediği ama satıcının mağazasında bulunan diğer ürünlerin satılması durumunda ödenecek komisyon miktarıdır.

Influencer Paylaşım Yönlendirmesi - Mağaza Ana Sayfa: Satıcının tüm mağazasına reklam vermesidir. Influencer'ın paylaştığı link doğrudan satıcının mağaza ana sayfasına gider ve mağazadaki tüm ürünlere reklam verilmiş olur.

Influencer Paylaşım Yönlendirmesi - Kategori ve Marka: Satıcının kendi seçtiği belli bir kategori ya da marka grubundaki ürünlerine reklam vermesidir. Influencer'ın paylaştığı link bu kategori ve markadaki ürünlere gider. Bu kategori ve markadaki ürünler için satıcı doğrudan komisyon öderken, mağazasındaki diğer ürünler için dolaylı komisyon öder.

Influencer Paylaşım Yönlendirmesi - Ürün Grubu:  Satıcının kendi seçtiği belli bir ürün grubundaki ürünlerine reklam vermesidir. Influencer'ın paylaştığı link bu seçilen ürünlere gider. Bu ürünler için satıcı doğrudan komisyon öderken, mağazasındaki diğer ürünler için dolaylı komisyon öder.

Influencer Paylaşım Yönlendirmesi - Sponsorlu Koleksiyon: Satıcının seçtiği ürünlerine dilerse farklı komisyon oranları da belirleyip açabildiği reklam modelidir. Influencer belli bir konsept dahilinde kendi oluşturduğu koleksiyona istediği satıcıların istediği ürünlerini ekler ve duyurusunu yapar. Satıcı bu koleksiyon içerisinden ürünleri satılırsa sadece doğrudan komisyon öder. Burayı satıcı tekli ürün tekliflerinin pazar yeri gibi düşünebiliriz.

Trendyol Dışına Yönlendir: Satıcılar dilerse Trendyol platformu dışında bir reklam anlaşmasına gidebilirler. Eğer Influencer Trendyol Dışına Yönlendir tıklanmış bir teklifi kabul ederse, satıcı ile mail yoluyla iletişim kurar ve Trendyol bağımsız bir reklam anlaşması yapabilir.

Eklenmek İstenen Mention: Influencer'ın paylaşımı yaparken,  kullanılmasını istediğiniz caption’ları bu alanda belirtebilirsiniz.

Influencer Sınırlandırma: Satıcıların çalışmak istemediği influencer'ları seçtikleri alandır. Satıcı tarafından sınırlandırılan bir influencer, o satıcının tekliflerini hiç göremiyor ve dolayısıyla kabul edip paylaşamıyor olacaktır.
